column19: Debbo fere mo duuɓi cappan e ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti bal e tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hande. Dembo ko ndei jungo mako kosde be bandu mako pat do fewi delem har do holla mo to o memi bingel man be jungo mako har dikka o hosa mo ha der sabbo hakkilini bingel man sali en bandu mako do fewi to be memi dembo bandu man do bedda watugo har o wala. Jungo mako forta kosɗe bo wala dimba sam oɗo wali babal gotel tan to alari ɓingel manni oɗo yonti bo nyaungel ɗume dasi bannin man ɗum a numata dasata ɓandu ɓikkoi keccon fewa delem to goɗɗo memi ko gam o sali musungo on tan ko game on. Re min wawatauffedu hala salare kosam en ɗi man nden bo hala riga handi min jaɓa man ɗume on shawara ma ha dou man. Dembo ko ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti bal e tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hande.

column18: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. O ɗo tani habda be mai ɓe sarimo o yara hundeji fere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni ɓe vi mo o tammi waɗugo dama ɓe lari mo nda ɓe vida ko shafi nda ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba. Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Be vi o siwta be wadi sembe iyam mako fahin be tawi on fifti ovati be lari bo odo be redu to sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako do va’i je marɓe redu gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumu redo be yecci mo Kala hundeji fu je o watta bandu mako hundeji tornata mo sosai watata sembe iyam mako bedda amba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu ɗo je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toi hosata ha dou redu. Tatta har debbo ɗo jima.
column19: Futtugo yeso be kosɗe, hawtaade be sembe iiyam dillo haa 150/80, ko alamaaji normal haa debbo marɗo reedu ngam ɓiɗɗo heɓa iiyam boɗɗum. Haani o acca yarugo lekki sembe iiyam man wakkati gooto ngam ɗum ɗon hokka ɓiɗɗo reedu rafi sembe. Ngam usta naawalla hoore be futtugo man, wi'i mo o ɓesda lamdam ɗuɗɗam nder nyamdu maako ngam ɗum walla ndiyam worta daga ɓandu. O lora o ɗaana haa saare nder jam, o fawta yaago asibiti fahin ngam taa likit'en ɓesdana mo damuwa. Ɗum fuu ɗon holla ɓiɗɗo ɗon mawna e jam, gam majjum walaa ko haani hultorgo sam.

column18: Dada debbo je danyi neɓai wari sibiti o vi tun ɓingal mako dayi odo ta rufa iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako denbo mo danyi mai dubi mako nogas e nai o vi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi nyamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodum. Yonde amjum ɗum waddata debbo ninga rufugo iyam ɗo ɓawo dayi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaundiku toi ɓe hokkata dada mai je rufugo iyam mai darata denbo o lorna sembe mako shawara hokkata dada mai be ɓingel mako.
column19:
Miɗo yiɗi yo a yaha da hospital/clinic haa a tottir ko woni, sabu hujjo dumɗe (ɓarnaaɗe) kala e kese baafal, sankira, ko goongaare e ɓernde (ɓayda) naatata.
Rewde e njuru-ɗaa e minndol kaarol no feewi, wonaa ko aɗa waawi waawde waɗude ngam barke, sabu kaarol goɗɗo ina mbaawi ɓeydude ruuhu, ɓernde, walla ɓoyde mbarɗe.
So aɗa yana ruuhu kala, saare, feber, haɓɓe jini, ko njoɓdi ndiyam, walla nana sokli baafal sosai, yo a waɗa to hospital ko haani.
Hakkille, a naamno ndiyam haa ɓuri, a ɓeydu ko aɗa waawi ñamde, tee hoto kaarol baafal doole so aɗa njuru-ɗaa ko feewi, haa doktoor on waɗi ko feewi.

column18: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
column19:
Alamaaji ɗi a limti ɗon holla masibo mawɗo; iyam wurtotoɗam be ketuuji, naawalla les jaaburu, e tampiri daada ɗon holla nyawu mboobu (infection) koo kedde danygol (retained placenta), nden ɓingel chanji e nguleefi ɗon holla ngel heɓi nyawu cemuɗam (neonatal sepsis).

Taa yardu e haala rewɓe wiyooɓe ɗum mere, ngam ɗum naa al'aada ndiyam ɓaawo danygol boɗɗum; on danyi haaje yahaago asibiti wakkati oon ngam likita en ndaara daada e ɓingel.

Zubar ƴiiƴam ɓaawo danygol e nyawu ɗon wadda naawalla reedu e soofugo ɓanndu, nden bo ɓikkoy keccoy ɗon yaawa waatugo to ɓe keɓi nyawu mboobu.

Ngam faddugo ɗum, daada handi tokka laaɓal ɓanndu, jaɓa lekki ƴiiƴam, nden bo o yaha asibiti (postnatal care) ngam taa nyawu nanga mo koo ɓingel.

Yawnee yahu asibiti wakkati oon ngam heɓugo laggol mboobu (antibiotics) e hisnugo yonki daada e keccel ngel.

Jukalel ngel no e haala nyawu mawɗo: ko o heɓi nguleendi, o waawataa jaabaade, gite/ɓalli mum no wayi haaɗi—ɗum ena waɗi min tuuma **malaria tiiɗnde (cerebral malaria)** walla **meningitis/sepsis**, hara ɗum ko gollal jaawngal.
Ɗum hinaa padde/epilepsy tan haa min ƴeewi mo; min waɗata sukaru ƴiiƴam, test malaria, PCV, ƴiiƴam ɗiɗi, e ƴeewtagol meningitis so ena woodi.
Pawtugol jaawngol: toppitagol ndiyam/oxygen so ena woodi, diazepam so o naŋgi, dextrose so sukaru leydi, **IV artesunate** ngam malaria tiiɗnde, e **ceftriaxone** ngam meningitis/sepsis.
Hoto ɓe naatnu mo ɗaɗi walla kosam/lekki saare nde o waawataa ɗaɓɓude, sabu ena waawi naatde henndu e ɓernde.
O foti wonde e asibiti, ɓe reena mo haa o yahrata e anndal e nguleendi leɗɗi.

column18: Debbo banga on duɓi amin e tati e joi usbi joi on lari amoti kugal ko yali amɗe tati sali ɗo mi hefti o ɗo fi kata ɗoja sosai ko ɗume je darnata. Ɗojugo mai amma mi lari accdai joɗugo ha sare to mi dilli be fajira se a warta jego dada am on joɗata be ɓingel am kala deɓi wakkati yonugo min ɗo yona min nana ko ɗo yecca am woɓɓe. Ɓingel ambi joi on kosam ɓe fuɗɗi yahugo kugal mi dayi miɗo kosam mi yarni mo kosam je lebbi tati mi fuɗɗi hokkugo mo nyamduji fere miɗo hokka mo. Nyamduuji kala kala bana gaari be nyamdu ɓingel je mi andi ko yardi amma fofugo mako dana o fofi ba dan o vowi fofugo ba o wala fufa boɗɗum kuma mako sukki pat. vidum be hande wakkati o do yiwa mo be fajira sanga o naftiri ndiyam jumjum ha kine mako be haberde mako gam ndamba mai sati fofugo mai fuddi o acci fofugo boɗɗum kuma fofugo mai acca kuseni. on min naftirta hamaku je acca tabba mai kuma hala fufugo mai je lebbi die waɗata mum kuma min wadata hala fufugo boɗɗum. haɗata mo fufugo.
column19: Ɗoja e ndamba ɓingel maa ɗon wara ngam o ɗon fuɗa nyiiye, ngam maajum walaa ko a hulata koo a yaha asibiti. Ngam a maasa kine maako ɗe sukki, hooy nebbam guluuji koo Robb a wuja caka nder kine maako ngam o heɓa fofugo boɗɗum. Kadima, hokku mo njumri (honey) e nder gaari maako nyande fuu, ngam njumri ɗon hisna ɗoja ɓikkoi ɓe lebbi jowi. Sakkiti, accita yarnugo mo endam faf, a ɓesdana mo nyamduuji tedduɗi ngam ɓokkol maako heɓa semmbe fofugo.

column18: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
column19: Nyau ɓingel ma ɗo ko jontere nde sanyi naati nder ƴi'e, kanjum waɗi ɓandu mako tiddi bo hunduko maɓɓi. O heɓan batal to a tokki wujja mo sabulu gargajiya mai haa ɓandu mako fuu ngam ɗum hoosa sanyi ɓandu mai. Heɓu cokali a tura haa nyi'e mako ngam a maɓɓita hunduko mai pacak, sai a loowa lekki gargajiya ɗon ngam o yara o tuuta nyau ɗon. Kadi bo, saawa mo be bargooji ɗuɗɗi koo to ɓandu mako ɗon wula, ngam guldum mai wurtina nyau ɗon be wukko. To a waɗi ɗum, ɓandu mako fukkan, ɓingel umman nden bo o fuɗɗan nyamugo nyiiri.

column19:
Ɓingel ngel e woodi caɗeele fooftaago e woyaare tiiɗnde, ɗum holla maande heege oksijen e jonta (asphyxia neonatale) maa caɗeele ɗon e nder daande fooftaago, ko ɗum waɗi ɓalli mbaɗa no alaa nalle.
Ko foti waɗeede ha asibiti ko yaawde: laaɓtina kinndu hunnduko e nofru, mooɓtina ɓalli ngel wulnaa, e wallude fooftaago bee foondaango so tawii haani.
So ɓingel dartii fooftaago, inna oo foti ñamnude kosam ɓernde (colostrum) tan, sabi ɗum woni nyamdu reenuki ɓurngu moƴƴude e o sahaa.
So ɓingel waawaa musindego, o waawi ɓiɗɗude kosam o hokku ɓingel e koppu laaɓɗo, ammaa woto hokku goɗɗum bana ndiyam maa leɗɗe.
Nyau nduu ɗaɓɓi toppitagol yaawngol to suudu safrirdu; inna oo alaa ko wawata hokkude ɓingel so wonaa kosam mum tan, haa doktoor timmina laawolngol.

column18: Inde amtilola daga keya bandu bingel am do wuli odo fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man wetata waituggo yite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dumejum on wawata wuda zazzabi do be ko bo hadata dande mako waituggo gol handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako waituggo jawabu toy bo be yecchata men je ko woni dar bandu bingel man je waddata zazzabi be ko wadata dande mako wodi go
column19: Tilola, zazzabi nguli bandu be dande nde wailitatta do, alama nyigge bingel man don pusa, dum waddata tannyugo kusel dande. Yitere nde o wawata mabbugo bo, ngam o tampi be diwuna man on, wala ko woni. Wala nyawu mangu nder bandu mako, peewol on nangi mo waddi damuwa man. Hokku mo paracetamol tan, bo wujju dande mako be nebbam bodi dam wuli ngam dande man wailita. O wadan jam, wala haje yahugo asibiti ngam beddugo ndaara ko woni nder bandu mako.

column18: Likita joɗata ha sare amin lari bingal mako wala mo sungo boddum je o yidi o musina mo sai bingal mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi dada mai bo hirliti bingal mai wala sembe musungo den bo odo vita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso da kanjum tamba denbo fofugo bingal mai. O ɗo fofa bana yaha dow ɓe ɗo jippa les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata balleji ɗo dillani dada mai ɗo ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel mai wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolungo ɓingel mai tos. o vi ha o yaha asibiti o lara likita hoinan mo bingal mako demne ame on latata bingal heba damuwa mo sungo boddum no bingal mai fofata do alama nyau fere don namaji hattara be baba mingal mai hakkilinta dume on watata bingel petel go to ɗo musina.
column19:
Ɗum ko alamaaji haɗari: ɓinngel no fofa yaawde walla ɓernde no naata les, o wala sembe, o ɗaɓɓaani ɗaɗɗa/njaram, o yartata fof, nguleendi mawndi, walla hunduko/koyɗe no laɓɓi.
Ɗum ena waawi wonde pneumonia, asma/bronchiolitis walla nyaw sepsis; sabu ɗum ɓinngel haani yahde asibiti jooni, hoto sabbo.
Haa ɗon yahude, waɗee mo no joɗi ɗow seeɗa, loosen kolte, laɓɓinee hanci so no ɗaɓɓi, hokkee ɗaɗɗa walla njaram seeɗa-seeɗa so o waawi ɗaɓɓude.
So nguleendi woodi, on waawi hokde paracetamol ɗo doosiiji ɓinngel, kono hoto hokku antibiotics, cough syrup, leppi walla magani ko likita yamiraani.
So o fota haa o waɗi sowru, o finta, walla o waɗi convulsion, noddee taimako/ambulance ko law.

column18: Gorko ambi mako cabble nai bo milliti sati ko sali ɗum o ɗo fita yara ndiyam sosai sosai no yarata ndiyam mai nonnon o silata to o yari ɗuɗɗum ma non kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadai de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o ɗo woka fu o nana. Bo o ɗo ɓeddi ɓandu seɗɗa wakkati fere o ɗo fiya o ɗo lara daure o wala lara boɗɗum to o ummi o ɗo wanca mirliti o ɗo silla akai be ɗuɗɗum bo ɗume on watata sendugo. Ɗo be ɗonka ɗo kwaɗi o yarata ndiyam ɗuɗɗum denbo o ɗo silla ɗuɗɗum ko alamaji ɗo wawan je yahu shuga ko hundeji fere ɗon aunugo be ko ji waɗata heɓa hefta irin nyautoy ɗon ɗo ko waɗi o ɗo somi kullum ɗo ɗume on waddata silugo akay ɗo. Ɗo sembe iyam mako ɓamti ɗon waɗata nyauɗo ko ndiyam ɓandu mako timmina ko kuje fere ɗon tan irin nyiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma ɗume on handi o dinga nyamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji ɗo de handi noi be hollugo je shuga handi waɗa kullum ko. Yonde go nyau toi ɗon waɗata alamaji ɗo je feɗata ha ɓandu mako.
column19: Alamaji ɗi a limti ɗo, irin yarugo ndiyam ɗuɗɗum, sillugo koondeye haa e jemma, sombo, e lallaago gite, ɗon holla gorko oo ɗon mari nyau shuga (Diabetes) e tawe ɓamtol ƴiiƴam (Hypertension). Sillugo e ɗonka ɗuɗɗum ɗon waɗa ngam ɓandu mako ɗon tefa wurtinki shuga ɓurtunɗo nder ƴiiƴam mako ta laawol sille. Diga jooni hani o yaha asibiti ngam likitaajo auna shuga ƴiiƴam mako koo o nyaamai (Fasting Blood Sugar) e ɓetol ƴiiƴam (BP) ngam tabbatingo nyau man e hokkugo mo lekki. Ngam ustugo ɗum, o wajiba o acca yarugo kuuje mari shuga e nyaamduji swiiti, o usta nyaamugo nyiiri ɗuɗɗum, kadi o ɓedda nyaamugo haakooji e ɓiɓɓe leɗɗe. Hosaago lekki asibiti e wakkati, tokkugo laawol nyaamdu boɗɗum, e waɗugo jarsiisi wallitan ustugo alamaji ɗi fuu haa o heɓa jam, o hisa daga masibo nyau shuga.

column19: Nyawu nguu ko tampere danygol, ɓingel ngel haaji semmbe ngam ngel woya boɗɗum. Ngam a woyna ngel kadi fooftere maggel fesa, lootu ngel e ndiyam peewɗam lawlaw ngam ngel fina. Baawo ɗon, hokku ngel ndiyam ngulɗam jillindiraaɗam e suukara malla njumri ngel yara. Yaraande ndee hokkan ɓingel semmbe nder ƴiiƴam lawlaw ngam ngel heɓa yamɗugo. Taa hokka ngel masin henndu (oxygen) tukun, tokku laawol ngol tan ngel warta jam.

column19:
Ɗum ko alamaaru haɗiiɗum ɓawo jibingol: sembe alaa, gite yi’ataa laaɓi e ɗoyɗeende ina waawi wonde ƴiiƴam ɗuuɗum yaltinii mo, BP ɗowii, sukaru lownii walla infection.
Ngarnee mo asibiti jooni ngam a ƴeewta BP, ƴiiƴam/Hb, sukaru, urine e no reedu/bleeding woni; hoto on ɗow mo e suudu tan.
To o waawi lumude, o wurtataa, hokkee mo yi’am walla ORS/kaɓilungo yi’am seɗɗa-seɗɗa, kadi hokkee mo nyiri newiriɗi: kunu/akamu, miya, shinkafa, wake, kifi/nama.
Si ƴiiƴam ɗuuɗum ɗo yalta, o ɗo faint, o heɓii fits, hoore mettii, o ɗo honyugo walla fever, ɗum ko gawat—ngarnee mo asibiti yaasi.

column18: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
column19: Bana no o lari alamaaji ɗi'i, hunde satiŋde nder endi fuɗɗi naawugo be ɓuutuwa, ɗum ɗo nufa endi man heɓi mboordi (pewuri) ko bo ketungol nyau daji (kansa). Mboordi ko daji nder endi ɗo waɗa ɓuudi satiŋdi, ɗo naawa, bo babal man ɗo woya ngam kwayaaji nyau ɗon mooɓta nder ɗon. O haandi o yaha asibiti lawlaw ngam likita'en mema lara endi man, ɓe waɗa hoto (scan) ngam ɓe tabaatika asali ɓuudi man. To ɓe tawi nyau man law, likita hokkan mo magani ko ɓe waɗa seere pamarde ngam ittugo ɗum, ngam non taa o fasa ko o mema ɗum kanko e hoore mako ngam ta nyau man ɓedda.

column18: Dada debbo je danyi neɓai wari sibiti o vi tun ɓingal mako dayi odo ta rufa iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako denbo mo danyi mai dubi mako nogas e nai o vi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi nyamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodum. Yonde amjum ɗum waddata debbo ninga rufugo iyam ɗo ɓawo dayi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaundiku toi ɓe hokkata dada mai je rufugo iyam mai darata denbo o lorna sembe mako shawara hokkata dada mai be ɓingel mako.
column19:
Ngam kuje ɗo, haaji laartuggo debbo ɗon bee yaawre ngam ruffugo iyam ɓaawo danygol:

1. **Semmbiɗingo ɓandum mako:** Sey ɓe tinna ɓe semmbiɗina ɓandum mako bee lamba (IV fluids) nden ɓe waɗana mo iyam (blood transfusion) ngam o kaas-iyam masin.
2. **Hokkugo lekkiiji:** Sey ɓe hokka mo lekkiiji ba *oxytocin* ko *misoprostol* heɓa reedu mako taara (contract), ruffugo iyam ɗon horta.
3. **Laartuggo ko waɗi:** Sey ɓe waɗana mo hotto reedu (*ultrasound scan*) ngam laara to woodi ko luttii nder reedu mako, nden ɓe hokka mo lekki kofotoboodi (*antibiotics*) to o ɗon heɓi jorfol (*infection*).
4. **Laɓɓingo reedu:** To iyam ɗon jokki ruffugo boo, haaji yaahugo suudu kireerugal ngam ɓe laɓɓina reedu mako (*uterine evacuation*).

column19: Bingel maa ngatti bosaru wawitiɗam (omphalite) ngonka ina waawi naatde e ƴiiƴam, waɗa rafi sepsis baawɗo warde ɓingel. Ɗum tooñaare laaɓndu; aɗa foti artude e ɓingel to asibiti ɓooyma ngam ɓe lootoo gaafe bosaru, mbaɗa antibiotik (injection) e ƴiiƴam. Woto fuɗɗoro huutoraade kala leɗɗe aada, nebam, malla ɓiɓɓe piirtuɗe e dow gaafe, ɗum ɓeydaa njeññina e hoɗre. To opitaal, ɓe mbaɗat kadi tetanus prophylaxis so tawii yumma mum heɓaani nyawndu nduu e reedu. Toppitaa ɓingel ngel e nokku laaɓɗo, ngoppuɗo gaafe ɓuuɓɗi, haa ɓe ngoppitaa safrude e asibiti haa timma.

column19: Ko nyawu mawɗi ɗi ngamɗam ɗe wasiya yo ɗon yah asibiti haawti ngam testiji e examination, lekki gargajiya acca tan ɗo ngalaa faayda. Daada ɗo mari dojjugo (seizures) e fofugo (swelling) ɗe waawi wonde epilepsi, kidney disease, wala hypertension - testiji ɗe gawne (blood, urine, EEG) ngalaa haaju ngam anndugo ko woni. Ɓingel ngel ɗo mari dojjugo e ustugol (wasting) ɗo waawi wonde malnutrition wala infection (ko wayi no meningitis) - examination e asibiti ngalaa haaju haawti. Nyawu nguu ɗo ngalaa keerol, ɗo waawi bonnugo ɓeyda e ɗe ngamɗam wakkati ɗo ngalaa mawni - ɗon yah asibiti haawti.

Iyam e kureeji (clots) vurtooji ɓaawo danygol satti ɗiɗi nandi e heddungo kuuje danygol nder reedu (retained placenta/membranes) malla jonte nder saare danygol, kanjum waddata nawalla les reedu. Tampiri e ɓurtugo ɓernde ma ɗon waddama ngam ustagol iyam (anemia) malla kuuje mettamɓernde ɓaawo danygol.

Kujeji meeraaji ɗi dada kesum haandi lara ngam hakkilango yo: to iyam ɗon vurta ko heewi, urdi mbonndi ɗon vurta, jontere ɓanduu, malla nawalla reedu burtuka. Haandi a yaha asibiti yaasi ngam likita’en ndara ma, ɓe njuurto to woodi kuuje keddiɗe nder reedu ma mbel ɓe njaara ma lobbo.

Kadi, tokkugo yaadu asibiti ɓaawo danygol (postnatal care) e heɓugo siwtaare be nyaamdu lobbu ɗon wallita dada kesum sanne ngam heɓugo sellingo timmungo.

Ngam wallugo ɓingel ngel, wara taarugel nder bargooji tekkuɗi ngam ngel wula zazzabi man yalta daga ɓandu. Nyo'u cokali njamndi nder hunduko maggel wakkati ngel dimbata ngam taa ngel nappa ɗemngal maggel. Loowu nebbam boɗeejam nder hunduko maggel koo to ngel walaa nder hakkilo, ngam ngel finta law. Darta hokkugo ngel endam wakkati man sabo endam maada on waddi zazzabi be dimbugo man.

column18: Inde amtilola daga keya bandu bingel am do wuli odo fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man wetata waituggo yite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dumejum on wawata wuda zazzabi do be ko bo hadata dande mako waituggo gol handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako waituggo jawabu toy bo be yecchata men je ko woni dar bandu bingel man je waddata zazzabi be ko wadata dande mako wodi go

Ɗum ɗum alaamaaji ɓurtuɗi: zazzabi mawɗo e ñaw dande/waawataa lootugol, yite boɗɗe, walla waawataa ñaamugol/yarugol.
Ko sabu mum waawi wonde tonsillitis, malaria, measles, walla ko ɓuri hulɓinde—meningitis; sabo ɗum waɗi, a yahdu e bingel ngal sappo-sappo to asibiti/dispensary jooni.
Hoto on addan mo magani antibiotics walla injections e suudu tawa dokita yi’aali, kono on waawi hokku mo paracetamol ɗumɗum ngam zazzabi (15 mg/kg kala awaaji 6) e ndiyam seeɗa-seeɗa so o waawi yara.
So o woni ɗaɓɓude, o yiɗaa yara, o waɗi fits, o ɗaɓɓi moƴƴere, walla dande mako na ɗiiɗi/na tippi—ɗum ko emergency.
Dokita maa ƴeewto malaria test, throat/tonsils, measles, e alaama meningitis ngam hokkitinde magani moƴƴo.

column18: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. Ɓe hultiri hanjum madi ɓe waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.
column19: Ɓingel ɗon mari alamaji sariya pofɗe ta'aade (severe pneumonia), nden ɗum woni daliila ngal o waawataa hootugo saare, sey en naatna mo asibiti jotta. Lekki ɗojugo ngal dada mako hokkata mo wallataa mo, nden ɗum ɗon ɓeyda mako challungol hallugo ha ɓikki tokosɓe bana lebbi jego. Sey en binda mo asibiti, en hito pofɗe mako, en hokka mo oksijin to o ɗon haaje, nden en puɗɗa mo lekki batir (antibiotics) bee ndiyam murtiniingal (IV fluids). Doon kadi, en ngada bincikeji bana foto gaba (chest X-ray) e jiiɗam mako ngam en annda daliila nawnande mako jotta. Yarinki mo saare jotta ɗon waɗi masiibo mawɗo ngam hisgo yonki mako, nden sey en tinna en naatna mo mbarata.

column18: Gorko ambi mako cabble nai bo milliti sati ko sali ɗum o ɗo fita yara ndiyam sosai sosai no yarata ndiyam mai nonnon o silata to o yari ɗuɗɗum ma non kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadai de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o ɗo woka fu o nana. Bo o ɗo ɓeddi ɓandu seɗɗa wakkati fere o ɗo fiya o ɗo lara daure o wala lara boɗɗum to o ummi o ɗo wanca mirliti o ɗo silla akai be ɗuɗɗum bo ɗume on watata sendugo. Ɗo be ɗonka ɗo kwaɗi o yarata ndiyam ɗuɗɗum denbo o ɗo silla ɗuɗɗum ko alamaji ɗo wawan je yahu shuga ko hundeji fere ɗon aunugo be ko ji waɗata heɓa hefta irin nyautoy ɗon ɗo ko waɗi o ɗo somi kullum ɗo ɗume on waddata silugo akay ɗo. Ɗo sembe iyam mako ɓamti ɗon waɗata nyauɗo ko ndiyam ɓandu mako timmina ko kuje fere ɗon tan irin nyiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma ɗume on handi o dinga nyamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji ɗo de handi noi be hollugo je shuga handi waɗa kullum ko. Yonde go nyau toi ɗon waɗata alamaji ɗo je feɗata ha ɓandu mako.
column19: Alamaji ɗi ɗon holla ɓokkooji (kidneys) maako ɗon mari peewol, ɗum saabi o ɗon silla ndiyam ɗuɗɗum. Dulla gite bee mirligo maako ɗon waɗa ngam ndiyam ɗuɗɗum ɗam o yarata ɗon loota vitaminji gite maako. Ndi'i nyau walaa kawtal bee nyau shuga (diabetes), ammaa famɗugo shuga nder iyam maako saabi ɓandu ɗon woya ndiyam akay. Ngam o heɓa jam, o handi o usta yarugo ndiyam koo seɗɗa, bo o ɗinga nyamugo nyiri bee shuga ɗuɗɗum ngam ɓokkooji ɗin ngula. Walaa haaje o yaha asibiti ngam aunugo shuga; sey o hufa limse nguli o ɗaana ngam nyau man timma.

Debbo do danyi ha sibiti meden lebbi jego ko saali. Owari sibiti man beh gorko mako haa o danyi bingel mardo lebbi jego mo be wardi beh mako jonta .
Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.
Ovi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda.
Ovi dojjere man halli on daga keya. Balde tati ko fuddi amma har turti.
Ovi de o musini mo fu, odo hokka mo lekki diyam jeh der gora- jeh be sorrata jeh dojjugo do- jeh o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara.
Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.
Bana pofde man to ta’a on do yaha dau jippa les kala wakkati fu.
Beh hultiri hanjum wadi beh waddi mo sibiti meden.
Jotta emol am hado hanjum on; min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo beh bingel do ha saare na? Larugo no pofde mako ta’ata beh dojjere do?

Taa accitu debbo on hoota saare be lekki dojjere tan, ngam poofde ta'oore e gabaare loppotoonde ɗon holla ɓingel ngel wondi be nyawu pofɗe cattuɗum (*severe pneumonia*).

Sey a nasta ɓingel ngel asibiti (admit) ɗon e ɗon, a lornana ngel poofde (*oxygen*) to haaje waɗi, bo a fuddana ngel pije (*IV antibiotics*) ngam hisnugo yonki maggel.

Hokkugo ɓingel lebbi jeego'o lekki leɗɗe malla lekki dojjere ceeɓaaki haa kanti walaa nafuura, kadi ma ɗum ɗon hallina nyawu man sosai.

Aanaa a waɗa bincike/ndaarndaaki bano hooto gabaare (*chest X-ray*) e ndaarugo ƴiiƴam ngam a tabbatina asali nyawu man hiddeko a timmina harka lekki.

Haa asibitiiji gure meɗen, sey a famtina daada'en taa ɓe nyawnda ɓikkon haa saare be leɗɗe, sey ɓe wadda asibiti lawlaw to dojjere fuɗɗi ngam taa tura yotta ɗo.

column19: Alamuje ɗe ɗe cifaa ko ɓuuɓri ƴiiƴam henndu (pneumonia) walla bronchiolitis, ɗum ko ñawbuuji keewɗi e sukaaɓe tokosɓe. Tari maako yaajɗo e jamma, heɓgol henndu yaawngol (fufa be lau), e coorɗe ɗeɗɗe nder ɓalndu (keccel wokan) ko sabu ɓuuɓri ndi yani e paabi ɗi henndu naatata ɗii, ko ɗum saɗtina gallol kammu. Yaawgol haalaaji ɗii ko maande ñawu nguu tiiɗii, ko ɗum waɗi ina teeŋti no feewi yaawnude yahde to safrirde ngam ƴeewde ɓingel ngel, ƴeewde hayre mum, e rokkude kammu (oxygen) so ina haani. Doktoor tan ko waawi rokkude leppi ngam hisnude ɓuuɓri ndii (antibiotics) walla leppi ballitooji udditgol paabi ɗii caggal nde o ƴeewta ɓingel ngel. Woto rokku ɓingel ngel leppi ɓurtuɗi e hoore maa, kono ndokku muumɗum ɗam ɓuuɓndam ñalawma kala ngam yaafnude paabi ɗii haa nde ɓe njaltata to safrirde.

column19: Ko likita on wi'i ko goonga, sabu ɓiɓɓe dayaaɓe ɓe heɓaayi balɗe (premature) ɗon yaawi heɓugo rufugo suukara nder iyam (hypoglycemia) e rafi sepsis sabu ɓanndu maɓɓe woodaa sembe. Ɓingel ngel woodaa "glycogen" (cukara mo ɓanndu mooftata) heewɗo nder hecceere, ɗum waɗi sembe mako ɗon rufa yaasi to o nyaamaayi ko heewi. Wulugo ɓanndu e fewugo juuɗe e kose ɗon holla rafi "neonatal sepsis", ko waɗi likita on hokki mo batal cukara (IV Dextrose) ngam darnugo rufugo suukara on kisa. Nyaamugo nono inna ɗon wallita hokkugo ɓingel ngel sembe, cukara, e kuuɗe darnooji rafiiji (antibodies) ngam haɓaade rafi. Ɗum woni laawol ɓurngol moɓɓugo ngam dandugo ɓiɓɓe ɓe heɓaayi balɗe nder asibituuji men.

Based on your description, this appears to be a **postpartum woman (recently delivered) presenting with fever (38.2°C), body aches, and joint pain, with a confirmed malaria diagnosis** — this is a serious situation requiring careful management.

Ndaa ko mi wi'ata:

**Debbo danyɗo ɗo mari malaria e nawnaare ɓalɗe (fever 38.2°C) — ɗum ko caɗtuɗum, kono maa a hokku ɓe uncomplicated malaria** — hokku ɓe **Artemether-Lumefantrine (Coartem)** ko ɓe njarata laabi ɗiɗi ñalnde tati (naange fuɗɗi e hiirnde), tawa ɓe njoni sanne, sabu ɗum ko safaara ɓura moƴƴude e postpartum. Tiiɗno paracetamol e fever jaɓndeeru njarataa mo jaŋgo, ammaa **ndaaru mo no feewi**: to nawnaare heewi (ɗo ɓura ñalɗe tati), to o wuli sanne, to o alaa yarude, walla to o waɗi ndiyam heewɗam (bleeding), yaltin mo yo o yah suudu safrooru mawnundu. Fahin ndaaru **anemia** (ƴiiƴam ustii) sabu o danyi e o mari malaria, so no waawi ndaaru **haemoglobin/PCV** e ndaaru infection goɗɗo (sepsis) sabu 38.2 e postpartum ina foti ndaaru puerperal sepsis. Yamir mo yo o yara ndiyam heewɗam, o ñaama, o dañ boɗɗam, e to fever timmaani ñalnde ɗiɗi, o warta lella.

Ɓingel lebbi joyi mo saare/ɗojugo balɗe 13–14, o waawaa yarugo walla o tampii no feewi, ko **tampere mawnde**—waɗee mo **sibiti jooni**, hinaa lekki suudu.
Ngam yahde sibiti, hokkitee mo **ORS** seeɗa-seeɗa kala ɗakiikaaji seeɗa e jokku **nono**, amma so o wuttii kala ɗam walla o waawaa yarugo, accitee hokkugo ley hunduko.
Ha sibiti min ndarata kuivde ndiyam, malaria, sepsis, e sukar; so kuivde ndiyam ɗuuɗi, min hokkata **Ringer lactate/normal saline IV**.
Hokkitee **zinc 10 mg ñalnde kala balɗe 10–14**; antibiotic hinaa ko hokkata kala saare, sey so jiiɗam woodi e saare, kisaare mawnde, cholera, walla sepsis.
Accitee **lekki damba/traditional** ngam ina waawi ɓeydude tampere e waɗde ɓingel o bonde.

**Jaabawol:**

Alamaji ɗe dada wi'i—iyam ka duuɓe (lochia) je vurtata ɓawo danyugo, ɓingel mo o mari kadi mo mari vodai (jaundice/kesol), be tampol mako be munyaari ka ɓandu mako—ko alamaji je hanndude reftol likita, wanaa haala je waɗeten sai be munyaani.

**Ko mi wi'ata:**
1. Iyam je vurtata ɓawo danyugo (lochia) ko hunde je feƴƴata ha balɗe 4-6, kono to ɗum ɗuuɗi walla to o mari uddu bonɗo, ko alama bone (postpartum hemorrhage walla infection) je hanndi reftol asibiti law.
2. Kesol ɓingel (neonatal jaundice) to ɓe tokka, ko waawi bonugo ha hakkille ɓinngel—hanndi ɓe yaha asibiti ngam ɓe ndaara iyam mako be ɓe ndokka ɓe safaara (phototherapy) to hanndi.
3. Dada je tampi, je alkasi be munyaari ka ɓandu, ko waawi wonugo anaemia (asewre ƴiiƴam) walla infection, ɗum kadi hanndi reftol likita.
4. Mi wi'a dada nde ta munyu—yaha asibiti law ngam ɓe ndaara mo be ɓinngel mako, sabu ɗee alamaji ko waawi wonugo je haɗata yontere to ɓe kokki safaara.
5. Sanaji je ndiyam (traditional/spiritual remedies) waawaa lomtinde safaara likita e ndee saa'i, hanndi reftol asibiti ngam danygol dada be ɓinngel.

column19: Alamaji ɗii—yarugo ndiyam ɗuɗɗum, silla ɗuɗɗum, weelo, e ɓeydaago ɓandu seɗɗa—kanje ngoni maandeeji nyau shuga (diabetes mellitus). O haani haayde nyaamduuji baaguɗi suukara no heewi bana keke, buuru laaɓuɗum, o ɓura nyaamugo ko wayi no maaro moƴƴo, alkamaari timmuɗi, ɓiɓɓe leɗɗe e li’al. So o nyau shuga o rewaani, ɗum waɗan fitinaaji mawɗi e ɓanndu makko, ko wayi no wumtugo gite, toƴe ƴi’e, rafi ƴiƴre ndeen e ɓernde. Ngam ɗum, o waɗa fooɗuki ɓanndu, o tokkita nyaamdu mo haani, o ɗaɓɓita e dow doktoor sahaa e sahaa ngam semmbe iyam suukara makko waddaago e dow laabi.

Nde ɓe njahata sibiti, yumma mum ina foti jooɗinde ɓingel ngel fewndo e tooƴde ƴiiƴam mum ngam henndu nduu waawaa sokde, kadi ɗofta ɓaalɗe ɗee nde o fofata ngam o waasa sokke ɗuum. column19: A person with a fever and chills, who also has a cough and body aches, should see a healthcare provider. These symptoms could indicate a respiratory infection, such as influenza or pneumonia. It is important to get a proper diagnosis and treatment, which may include rest, fluids, and possibly antibiotics. Avoid self-medicating, as it may worsen the condition. Early medical intervention can help prevent complications and promote faster recovery.

column19: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa gorko yana da matsalar "diarrhea" mai tsanani, wanda ya sa ya rasa ruwan jiki da sinadaran da jikinsa ke bukata. Yana da kyau a fara ba shi "Oral Rehydration Salts" (ORS) don mayar da masa ruwa da sinadar gishiri da sukari. Idan ba ya iya shan ruwa ko kuma yanayin ya kara tsanani, ya kamata a kai shi asibiti nan da sauri domin ya sami "IV fluids" (tsarin zuba ruwa ta jiki). Zazzabin yana iya kashe gorkon idan ba a ba shi kulawar daidai ba, musamman idan yana da rashin kuzari ko kuma yana fita da ruwa mai yawa. Dole ne a tabbatar ya sami abinci mai kuzari da kuma maganin kwayar cuta da likita zai ba shi don magance cutar.

column19: Suka on ɗo mari rafi meningitis (nawnaare ɓanndu hore) e rafi ɓeƴƴi (kidneys) sabu maande futugo yeeso e kosɗe, ɗum ɗon hawti e mboros mawɗo haani o ya'a asibiti mawɗo jooni-jooni. O haani o acca yargo leɗɗe gargaaji ɗen fow sabu ɗe ɗon ɓeyda nawnaare redu e ɓusugo, kadi ɗe ɗon halka ɓeƴƴi makko ɗin. Tama e typhoid ɗon halki, amma juɗe ɓeldi e rafi hore ɗon holla wonde ɓanndu hore ɗon nawni, haani dokita en ƴeewa ndiyam ɓanndu hore (lumbar puncture) e ƴiiƴam. Nguleeki hore e huccugo ɗum waɗataa ko haani, o haani o heɓa leɗɗe dokita (antibiotics) e ndiyam nder ɗaɗi ngam hisnugo nguurndam makko gila rafi on ɓeydaaki. Wada mo asibiti laawol ngol wootol ngam o heɓa wallifaare dokita'en nde haani, o acca yargo leɗɗe ɗe anndaaka.

Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
column19: Mako mo waddi sibiti heɓa e wawata waɗugo kanjum noon woni fitina fukara (severe anemia) tati o yahata ndiyam nden. Kuuɗa o waddi mo laawol ɓingel (hepatomegaly) e ɓingel ngalama (splenomegaly) tati o yahata talabiya ɓingel wala jangirde blood (thalassemia wala sickle cell). Likita o yami wadata laawol blood complete (FBC), blood film, electrophoresis, e liver function tests nden. Kuuɗa o sappo wara ndiyam (blood transfusion) to o waddata kanjum, saka vitamin folic acid, e yeeso likita specialist (pediatrician/hematologist) to jangirde. Kori jooni mako mo to hospital ndi gilla to wallude e dewgula laawol.

Taa accitu debbo on hoota saare be lekki dojjere tan, ngam poofde ta'oore e gabaare loppotoonde ɗon holla ɓingel ngel wondi be nyawu pofɗe cattuɗum (*severe pneumonia*).

Sey a nasta ɓingel ngel asibiti (admit) ɗon e ɗon, a lornana ngel poofde (*oxygen*) to haaje waɗi, bo a fuddana ngel pije (*IV antibiotics*) ngam hisnugo yonki maggel.

Hokkugo ɓingel lebbi jeego'o lekki leɗɗe malla lekki dojjere ceeɓaaki haa kanti walaa nafuura, kadi ma ɗum ɗon hallina nyawu man sosai.

Aanaa a waɗa bincike/ndaarndaaki bano hooto gabaare (*chest X-ray*) e ndaarugo ƴiiƴam ngam a tabbatina asali nyawu man hiddeko a timmina harka lekki.

Haa asibitiiji gure meɗen, sey a famtina daada'en taa ɓe nyawnda ɓikkon haa saare be leɗɗe, sey ɓe wadda asibiti lawlaw to dojjere fuɗɗi ngam taa tura yotta ɗo.

Bismillah. Ndaa ko mi yi'i e ɗemngal daaɗo:

Nawnaare ndee no wa'i wa **anemia mawnde (severe anemia)** je ɗon habda be dama mai (malaria) e nawnaare ummii be redu. Ɓeydari sembe iyam (blood transfusion) bee lekki dama no boɗɗum, ammaa ko ɓuri himmude, ɗum ɗon foti yeecude sabaabu maggo: yara hundeji fere (fatigue), uppa yeeso (facial swelling), namuki hore, e bandu fu hoore-nawnaare — ɗum fuu ina holla anemia ummi be nawnaare mawnde wolla nawnaare ɓernde.

Miɗo waawi wi'a hankadi tawa mo joonde ndaa ɗiin: **kaɗe redu (kidney)** wolla **ɓernde (heart failure)** foti wonde sabaabu uppki yeeso e bandu, kañum ɓuri wa'ude be dama mai jaɓɓungol. Ɗum waɗi tawa be waɗugo mo:
- **Urine test (fii proteins e redu)** e **kidney function test**,
- **Blood film for malaria parasites** e **full blood count**,
- **Hemoglobin electrophoresis** (sabu sickle cell ina waawi wonde e Nigeria).

Miɗo yeecoo mo ustaa mo he **hospital mawndu (referral)** ɗo woodi doctor mo nawnaare cukalel (pediatrician) e specialist redu, sabu nawnaare ndee no wa'i mawnde, alaa e sago wattee lekki tan e community hospital.

Alamaji ɗi a siftii—ɗufte/ɓirta ndiyam e hunduko, dande ko wa’i no jogii, hulde ndiyam, damuwa/tampere—ɗi mbaawi fota e **rabies** ɓawo ɗaɓɓere rawaandu, kadi jarrabooji asibiti ɗi mbaawi wonde “normal” kono rabies ɗon woodi.
So alamaji ɗi fuɗɗii, rabies ko nyaw bonɗo ɗo keewi ɗaɓɓude yonki; yahaa **emergency/asibiti mawɗo jooni**, hoto ɓooy.
So ɗaɓɓere ndee ko hesere, wuddo gulɗo ndee e saabulu e ndiyam ɗo yahata miniti 15, ngam heɓa **vaccine rabies** balɗe 0, 3, 7, 14, e **rabies immunoglobulin** to gulɗo so gulɗo no tiiɗi.
Hoto haɗ vaccine sabu rawaandu ndee no ndaartee balɗe 10; tetanus e antibiotic no waawi soklude.
Hoto mem ɗufte mako; kala mo saliva mako naati e gulɗo, hunduko walla gite, o yahaa heɓa kariya rabies.

Ɓingel maa ɗo ndiyam yiiwde e kosteji be juɗe (yaa woni oedema/heɓɓugo ndiyam), be ɓingel wonaango bana no woɗɓe, ɗum wonaa fijo — ɗum musiiba tokkugo likita law.

Ɗum wadata bana ɗum: ɓe foti ndaru ɓingel ha sibiti; hoore muuɗum foti ɓe ndaru ɓernde (heart failure) walla koyɗe/becce (kidney disease) walla ñawu ñebbe walla protein famɗugo e ɓandu (kwashiorkor).

Ɗo dada wannata ɗo ɓingel arta sibiti: hokku ɓingel ñaametee moƴƴe (breastfeeding walla nyaametee protein bana ndiyam-kosam, gujjo, njamndi), taa hokku lekki mbaawaa hoore muuɗum, be ɗaɓɓu ndiyam laaɓngu tan.

Amma ko ɓuri himmude: **ɓe njehu law ha sibiti**, likita foti ndaru ɓingel, wadde jarrabuji (ɓernde, koyɗe, ñebbe) haa ɓe keɓa ko wonata mo be nafta mo — ɗum wonaa fijo, tokkugo law waɗata ɓingel maa wonugo jam.

column18: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. Babal vallita ɓandu mako hoina seɗɗa ɗo pat nda pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laɓin sari mo to nyami ni sai o yara parasita mol to yari parasita mol mai timmi sei min lara dai on handi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria ko ma min waɗi mogoji mai us min hokka mo o timmini nyamugo nden bo min sari mo o yara parasita mo tonda o satai to dillai min handi nyau min hokka mo min hokkata.
column19: On ngaɗi boɗɗum sosai nde on suddi mo, on hokki mo paracetamol, ngam ɗum tampiri e malaria ɓaawo danygol. Tokke suddoogo mo bee bargooji tedduɗi ngam o waɗa wuli wurtina nguleeki ɓandu maajum pat. Vi'e mo o acca musinngo ɓingel ngel tukun ngam taa ngel yara kosam wulɗam ngel heeɓa nyawu malaria maajum. To ɓandu mako ɗon tokki wulgo, ɓedde ɗuuɗɗugo paracetamol maajum tan, bo on tokka hokkugo mo sha'i wulɗo. Walaa haaje bincike malla kuɓɓi (antibiotics), o waran jam kanko e ɓingel mako nder balɗe seɗɗa.

column19: Wannan ɗan ƙaramin yaro yana da matsalar rashin numfashi (asphyxia) wanda yake da haɗari sosai ga rayuwarsa. Dole ne a ba shi numfashi na gaggawa (CPR) da kuma samar da hanya mai buɗe don sa numfashinsa ya yi daidai kafin a kai shi asibiti. Rashin numfashi yana sa jikin yaron ba zai sami ƙarfi ba, kuma tsoron da mahaifiyarsa take da shi ba zai taimaki yaron ba idan ba a samar da kulawa ta likita ba. A asibiti, likitoci za su duba numfashinsa, zuciyarsa, da kuma tabbatar da cewa ba yana da cutar da ke hana shi numfashi ba. Dole ne a mayar da hankali kan samun numfashi nan take domin ceton rayuwarsa daga mutuwa.

column19: Jam naa, mi faami huuwaande maa. Kuuɗe gaañannde booraande (stump) ɗon lortoo saabunde malla ɗaɓɓaande no nyaw sukkara (diabetes) walla keejam nder kosngal (osteomyelitis) waɗi ɗum wuurtaaki. Mi wasiyotoo maa yahugo asibiti mawnde ngam safroowo yi’ata gaañannde nden, waɗa test sukkara e X-ray, o hokka maa antibiotik so ɗum haani. Hakkunde majjum, laɓɓinu gaañannde nden ndiyam laaɓɗam e saabonnde tokoose nyalnde fuu, ɓoornu dawayru laaɓndu, woto huutoroo lenyol gelooji. So ɗum wuurtaay haa balɗe ɗiɗi, yahugo doktoor ɗon ɓeyda himma.

column19: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa yaron yana da ciwon kwayar idon da ya yi tsanani, wanda ya iya zama sakamakon kwayar cuta (infection) ko kuma radadin zafin gari. Yana da kyau ka fara shafa masa ruwan dumi wanda aka zuba sabulu mai tsafta domin tsarke kwayar idon da ke damunsa. Idan idon ya ci gaba da ja'i ko yaron ya fara zargin jiki, ya kamata ka kai shi asibiti cikin gaggawa domin a ba shi magungin kwayar cuta (antibiotics) ko maganin zafin idon. column19: Ko ɗum ko sembe iyam ɗe debbo jahroowo woni (preeclampsia), ɗe o ndara ko ɓuuɓri ɓanndu, mette hoore, e mawnugol ƴiiƴam, ɗum noon ko nyawu bonɗu no feewi wonande yumma e ɓiyum. Leɗɗe ɗe o ndokkaa ngam ustude sembe iyam ɗe (jamu redu) ɗe ko ɗe mbaawi addande ko o ñaamata ko yaltata e ƴattooje ɓanndu, ɗum noon ina haani yo o hollite doktoor ko yaawi ngam waylude lekki man. Dowkugol koyɗe walla hoore fof alaa ko nafata ɗum, sabu ɓuuɓri ɓanndu ndi ko caɗe e nder reedu e ƴiiƴam (protein) woni ko addanta ɗum, wonaa ko dowri. Ɗum ko nyawu kaawisɗo no feewi wonande debbo jahroowo, ɗum noon omo haani nawteede to safrirde mawnde oon ñalawma. To safrirde nden, doktoor on maa jokku sembe iyam makko e reende ɓiyum e juuɗe mum.

column18: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
column19: Dada gorko ma wi'i gonga, ndiyam wakkati daygo on nati nder hoore e kine ɓingel ma, kanjum on waɗi damba haɗi mo fofugo. Ngam maganugo pewol man, a foti a acca musingo ɓingel ngel haa balɗe tati, sai dai a hokka mo ndiyam gulɗum jiilɗum be njumri seɗɗa. Wakkati a hokkata mo ndiyam man, ɓoɗa kine mako sukka ngam a tilasta mo o ekkita fofugo be hunduko mako. Kadi bo, wuju manja gulɗum dow hoore ɓingel man faat ngam ɗum yoora ndiyam ɗi nati nder hoore maajum. Ɗum on kugal likita'en ɓuri wooɗugo haa asibiti, to a waɗi bannii ɓingel ma yamɗitan, fofan boɗɗum, kadi o haran.

column18: Ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hande fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha maako sosai pat kuma ɗo sakli ta seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o vi meɗi feɗugo de ɗiɗi ko sali de fe’ata o ɗo nana. Na'um dembo iyam mai rufata a rufata ko redu on rufata o vi o anda ko o don mari redu ko odo vidu be em de o lari al ada mako o vi nebai ko o lari. Ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo iyam ɗo hande fatira puseni ɗum watata debbo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo banni mataki dagge hosata yaundi hokkata debbo ɗo. Hisnu yonki mako be darnata iyam mai lekkiji toy be bateji be hokkata mo je darnata iyam mai.
column19:
Debbo ɗo rufata iyam sosai e muusɗe reedu, eɓe waɗi mo ngam **haihuwa/roŋko woni** haa nde laɓɓini—haa huunde feewi, ɗum ina waawi wonde **ɓinngel ɗon seŋi (miscarriage)** walla **ciki ɗon ɗaɓɓi leydi reedu (ectopic pregnancy)**, ɗum haɗii yonki.
Mataki adii: **a waɗu vital signs**, waɗu **IV line ɗiɗi**, hokku **normal saline/Ringer lactate**, waɗu **PCV/Hb, grouping & cross‐match**, e **pregnancy test**, ngam so iyam heewi a ɗaɓɓita **jini**.
Ɗaɓɓita consent ngam **duba farji/speculum** e **ultrasound**; so miscarriage incomplete ne, likita waawi waɗude **MVA** walla hokku **misoprostol** e antibiotics/pain relief; so ectopic ne, o yiɗi **operation/urgent referral**.
To o ɗon rufude sosai, o ɗon fita, BP lesɗi, ko o ɗon hoosude, **hoto mo gila ɗo emergency/gynae theatre**—wonaa lekkol tan ngam darnude iyam.
Alaa no a hokkata “tablet darnata iyam” ko feewi tawa a anndaa sabu, sabu ɗum waawi suuɗde bala’i e ɓeydude haɗari.

column18: Dada je wondi ha daadiraɓe je waddata ɓikkoi maɓɓe tufugo batal o famtini o yiwi keccal mako ɗo mari damuwa ha hunduko mako ɓingel mai ɗo waɗi bulu hande sai o yisina ɓingal mai o ɗo turra. column19: Ɓingel ngel ɗon mari haaju yaaɓingo asibitijo koye-koye gam damuwa man ɗon addana ngel macca (shock) be caɗeele hendu. Dokkooɓe ɓe maɓɓita hunnduko mako, ɓe mbaɗa ngel ndiyam nder ɓanndu (IV fluids) walla ƴiiƴam ngam artirgo doole mako. Turragol be heɓataago hendu ɗon holla wonde ƴiiƴam mako ɗon usta no fe'ee, ɗum waawi maaygo de ɓe njippinaaki. Kada ku hokku ngel lekki gadaaje, ku yaaɓino ngel to asibitijo ngam ku waɗa ko dokkooɓe mbi'i. Tufugo ɓikkoi (FGM) ɗon adda nyawuuji bonɗi, nden on haani accugo ɗum gam hisnugo ɓikkoi mon.

column19: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa akwai matsalar jini ko kuma yanayin jini ya zama mai yawa (anemia) saboda rashin karfin jini da kuma faduwar karfin jiki. A asibiti, muna amfani da gwajin jini (Full Blood Count) don duba adadin kwayoyin jini da kuma sinadarin jini don tabbatar da dalilin wannan rashin karfi. Yana da kyau ka samu magungunan karfin jini (iron supplements) da abinci mai dauke da sinadarin jini don mayar da jiki da karfi. Idan rashin karfi ya ci gaba, yana bukatar bincike domin ganin ko akwai wata cuta ta jini ko kuma rashin abinci mai gamsar jiki. Ka nemi likita don a yi maka gwajin dukkan sinadaran jini domin a ba ka maganin da ya dace da yanayinka.

column18: Gorko ambi mako cabble nai bo milliti sati ko sali ɗum o ɗo fita yara ndiyam sosai sosai no yarata ndiyam mai nonnon o silata to o yari ɗuɗɗum ma non kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadai de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o ɗo woka fu o nana. Bo o ɗo ɓeddi ɓandu seɗɗa wakkati fere o ɗo fiya o ɗo lara daure o wala lara boɗɗum to o ummi o ɗo wanca mirliti o ɗo silla akai be ɗuɗɗum bo ɗume on watata sendugo. Ɗo be ɗonka ɗo kwaɗi o yarata ndiyam ɗuɗɗum denbo o ɗo silla ɗuɗɗum ko alamaji ɗo wawan je yahu shuga ko hundeji fere ɗon aunugo be ko ji waɗata heɓa hefta irin nyautoy ɗon ɗo ko waɗi o ɗo somi kullum ɗo ɗume on waddata silugo akay ɗo. Ɗo sembe iyam mako ɓamti ɗon waɗata nyauɗo ko ndiyam ɓandu mako timmina ko kuje fere ɗon tan irin nyiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma ɗume on handi o dinga nyamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji ɗo de handi noi be hollugo je shuga handi waɗa kullum ko. Yonde go nyau toi ɗon waɗata alamaji ɗo je feɗata ha ɓandu mako.
column19:
Alamaaji ɗi mbiɗa ɗon, bana yardugo diyam masin, sillugo koosaai, e somugo kullum, no holla wonki nyawu shuga (diabetes).

Ɗum ɗon waɗa ngam ɓandu maako waawaa huuturgo shuga ha ƴiiƴam maako booɗɗum, ɗum waɗa o sillata masin e o somata.

Handi o yaha sudu lekki yaasi ngam ɓe auna ƴiiƴam maako ngam ɓe taba tawa ɗum shuga on.

Ha joni, o accha nyaamugo ko yardugo kujeji ɗi woodi shuga masin, bana leemooji lodooji, o ɓesda nyaamugo kujeji gabaaji (vegetables).

**Sababuuji dande dow waawaa wailtaade e nguleeki:**
- **Meningite** (naɓɓol hoore/dande) ko caɗtungel: nguleeki, dande dolngel, ɓinngel haɓɓataa e yaltaa, feere hoore, e mbeeleeki.

- Woɗɓe: nguleeki dolngel jibinta seizure (yaayre), maa jontuki ndeexo.

**Ko foti waɗeede jooni:**
Naɓ ɓinngel to safrirde law-law, hara a fadaani. Ɓe foti ndaara sababu nguleeki e taro ndeexo. Wota accu tan e safaara suudu; meningite e tetanus ko caɗtungel maayanoojum so tawii safaara heɓaaka law. Alla hokke cellal.

Wailitugo noordi leɓi ɓingel man (cyanosis) e caɗeele fofugo wakkati muynol ɗum alaamaaji hollooje caɗeele nyau ɓerde danyaangal (congenital heart disease) malla nyau hanta (severe pneumonia) ɗon haɗa ƴiiƴam heɓugo mbeera (oxygen) heƴɗum.

Alaamaaji kalluɗum ɗi saarooji poti hakkilugo ngoni: leɓi malla ɗemngal ɓalewal, fofugo jaawngo, uumaango wakkati fofugo (grunting), e ligougo dube (chest in-drawing).

Ngam agaje arandeere, ɓamtee ɓingel ngam heɓugo weeyo, laɓɓinee kine muɗum to ɗon uddi, nden mboobee ɗum (Kangaroo Mother Care) ngam ɓandi wula de njaaroton asibiti yaawi.

Taa tiɗɗinee muyningo ɓingel ngal fofata boɗɗum ngam taa kosam nasta ɗatal fofugo (aspiration).

column19: Eey, ko rafi ɓingel ngel woni sabaabu ƴiiyam maa ɗam rufi, nde tawno o ŋakki ƴamde ɓural ngal no fotiri, ɗum noon ko ɗum woppata jippinde ƴiiyam ɗam. Ngam ƴellitde ƴiiyam ɗam, ina moxxi ɓamde ɓural ngal e juuɗe maa walla ɗaɓɓude ɓingel ngel ƴamde ngal sahaa kala, tawa a ɗaɓɓi ƴamde ndiyam keewɗam. Ngam ɓeydude maa semmbe e moxxude ɓanndu maa, a ɗaɓɓi ñaamde ɗoɗɗe (protein) e ñaamdu ndu alaa ko woni e mum cellal, e fooftere no fotiri. Nde ƴiiyam maa ɗam ƴellitii, ɓingel ngel ƴamata ɗum no fotiri, o ɗoyoyay, kadi maa heɓa semmbe ngam hakkillaade ɓingel maa.

Debbo do dayi ha amin fajira do. Veeti do o dayi. Dai owari jambi je tati be fajiri , mo wondi be mako ha sare yooni amin, vi debbo do bandu mako do duina bo do vuli sosai denbo odo mari damuwaaji ko shafi bandu mako je daamata sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai, min suddi mo be kare, mi hauni wulugo bandu mako, min tawi 38.2.
Min wanni mo goji be nawu chufi. Kam debbo do velnai, o nandi malariya . Min emmi mo ko woodi ko o yaami, ovi wala ko Oyami. Min yechi mo vondi be mako, be hokkamo shaa’i o yara. Min emmimo o musini hande na? Sai ovi dai owari musungo bingel mai, sai o tawi kecchel mai riiwi.
Sai minvi debbo mai o umma o hoods obaara bawo mako , heba vallita bandu mako hoina sedda da pat ba, amma vallitai bo gite mako Labai. Min sauri mo to yamini sai oyara paracetamol. To oyari paracetamol mai timmi , sai min lara dai don haadi minhokka mo fein. Odo mari malayria kuma min wani mo goji mai . Useni min waawanmihokka mo fein. To o timmini yamugo, denbo min sauri mo o yara paracetamol, tunda o saatai, to dillai ni minhandai yaudinde min hokkata.
column19: Wannan yanayin da kika bayyana yana nuna cewa debbo ɗo yana da ciwon malaria mai tsanani wanda ya kai shi matakin "severe malaria." Domin kare rayuwarsa, dole ne a kai shi zuwa asibiti nan da yanzu don ya sami magungiyar zuba jini (IV Artesunate) da kuma kiyaye matakin ruwan jikinsa. Ba ya kamata a bar shi a gida ko kuma a ba shi magungiyar sha kawai ba, domin ciwon yana iya sa shi ya rasa rai cikin kankanin lokaci. A asibiti, za a duba yanayin jikinsa, a ba shi magungiyar da za ta kashe kwayar cutar (parasites) a jini, kuma a kula da numfashinsa. Wannan tsarin magani ne da ake amfani da shi a yankinmu don kare rayuwar masu ciwon malaria masu tsanani.

To bingel ma ɗon ɗojja, boo ɗon fofa bee caɗeele (fofugo bee ker), ɗum alaama poyre (pneumonia) ko yiɗi yaadu asbitol joni-joni.

Hoto hokku mo goji, magunguna guri, walla lekki kossu yaasin ngam ɗum waawan bonnugo cellal bingel man.

Yaaru bingel man asbitol ɓurɗo ɓadaago joni-joni ngam likita’en ndaara mo, mballa mo bee lekki ko henndu fofugo (oxygen) to o ɗon mari haaje.

Tokku muyningo mo seeda-seeda to o ɗon mari dama, ammaa hoto doolee mo nyaamdu ko ndiyam ngam o lo'ata.

Ko feere waɗi, ɗum wonaa ka “taɓɓude” baawɗe njahdu e non; amma haɗa kaɓuru e ɗiɗi haa feere kaɗowol, jippu ɗemngo, wanka lewru e laɓɓe, e haɗa ɓe waɗata baawo ngel tun.
Njahdu ko e kaɓuru (pinworm) ena heɓoo e “tape test” subaka nder anal haa ɓuri gasa, so tawii ɓe wondi.
Nde tawii ɗoɗon feere e kaɓuru, ɓe njamira deworming (misali albendazole walla mebendazole) so a ɗo nder wattaaji fowruɓe (trimester 2/3), amma waɗ ko e laawol dokital ngal.
Miɗo yiɗi yo a waɗde ɗoɗon e hoore maa, a yaltinoo ndee ɓe yeeso dokita/chewko haa ɓe waɗ topirde kañum.

column19:
Bingel ngel ɗon nder bone heɓugo nyawu cirol (Rabies) ngol walaa safaara bee nyawu tetanos, kadi mbordi dakamti babal ngal ɗon hollita lekki gargajiya kin waddi nyawu kakkubɓuŋgu (infection) maajum.

Dole on yaara bingel ngel asibiti lawlaw ngam koo rawandu mai ɗon laaɓi, ndu waawan raaɓugo bingel ngel nyawu cirol mbaroowu.

Ha asibiti, likita'en lootay yammunde nde'e laaɓa, ɓe ndokka ngel lekki kakkubɓuki ngam mbordi ndi'i ɗaata (antibiotics).

Kadi bo, bingel ngel jaawdi yiɗi ficeego bocal cirol rawandu (Anti-Rabies vaccine) bee bocal tetanos ngam hisnugo yonki maagel.

## Faamnde e Jaabawol

Ɓinngel maa ngel woni e maale keɓɓe **preeklampsiya** walla **eeklampsiya** ɓaawo jibinannde (postpartum preeclampsia/eclampsia), ndeen ko haala teddungal kaɗ, teemede ɗoo:

**Maandeeji keɓɓe (danger signs):**
- Ɓandu fof feewi ndeer, terɗe kala teddi walla ɗi hebbi ndiyam
- Ɗum yaltini ley ley (ɓandu heewaani sembe, hoɗɗi)
- Jungo e kosɗe forti (rigidity/stiffness) - ngel ina foti wonde alaama seizure walla eeklampsiya

**Ko foti waɗeede jooni:**
1. **Yaadu asibiti mawnungel jooni jooni** - ngel maale ko urgency, ina foti heɓde tension checkugo e ndiyam ɓinngel (proteinuria).
2. Ndeen safaara mum ko **magnesium sulfate** ngam haɗde walla safrude eeklampsiya, e safaruuji tension ɗi ɓamtinta.
3. So ɓinngel ina waɗi konvulziyon walla o wonaa e hakkille, ɗum ko emergency mawɗo - **haɗ nyaamde walla yarde**, waɗ ɓinngel e sera (recovery position), ndaartaa faabo asibiti tafon.

Mi wiy-maa: **hoto woɗɗitin, hokku ɓinngel maa faabo asibiti mawɗo jooni jooni**, sabu preeklampsiya ɓaawo jibinannde ina wara so faabaaka law.

column19: Bingel maa ngatti bosaru wawitiɗam (omphalite) ngonka ina waawi naatde e ƴiiƴam, waɗa rafi sepsis baawɗo warde ɓingel. Woto fuɗɗoro huutoraade kala leɗɗe aada, nebam, malla ɓiɓɓe piirtuɗe e dow gaafe, ɗum ɓeydaa njeññina e hoɗre. To opitaal, ɓe mbaɗat kadi tetanus prophylaxis so tawii yumma mum heɓaani nyawndu nduu e reedu. Toppitaa ɓingel ngel e nokku laaɓɗo, ngoppuɗo gaafe ɓuuɓɗi, haa ɓe ngoppitaa safrude e asibiti haa timma.

**Jaabawol:**

Debbo dumji (dubi 30) mo woni e reedu je-ɗiɗaɓol (multigravida), mo woodi maale saɗeende reedu (danger signs) wano yeeso woyngo (facial edema), sembe hoore (headache), e naawka reedu — ɗum hollata **Pre-eclampsia**, saɗeende mawnde nde foti nde faytuki eclampsia (dami/convulsions) so ɓe nyaawaay ɗum law.

Ko foti waɗeede tafon ko: **hokka ɗum lekki dami caltingo dami (Magnesium Sulphate)** ngam haɗugo dami e reedu, e **hokka lekki jippingo ƴiiƴam (antihypertensive)** wano *Methyldopa* walla *Nifedipine* so ƴiiƴam mum ɓeydiima.

Kono, safaara timmuɗo pre-eclampsia ko **jibinaango ɓinngel** (delivery) — sabu tan so ɓinngel e placenta yaltii, saɗeende nde fusata; ɓe foti hokka ɗum reeru ha ɓe eggina ɗum yaawnde faade suudu safirdu mawndu (referral) ɗo woni doktoora rewɓe (obstetrician).

Refto ɗum ɗon, ɓe foti ƴeewa ƴiiƴam mum sahaa e sahaa, ɓe ɓetta protein e mbindi (urine), ɓe njokka feƴƴude reedu e cellal ɓinngel ngam reentaade lorla.

Faamii-am maale ɗe hbe bandu debbo e bingel mako. Miɗo yiɗi humpitde maale ɗe no laaɓi:

**Ummaade debbo:**
- Bingel ngel wari lekki jego (jego labbi), ɗum firti ko lekki jego wari e reedu.
- Dojjere (labor) ɗe njuuti balɗe sappo e tati haa sappo e nayi — ɗum ko dojjere juutunde, hono bofɗe (contractions) ɗe njuuti sanne.
- Yeeso yotti, bingel ngel wooданii, sabu bofɗe ɗe njuuti e tampere dojjere ndee.

**Ko mi yiɗi humpitde:**
1. **No debbo oo woni jooni?** Hade mo yeewde ƴiiƴam heewɗam (postpartum hemorrhage)? Ndaaree reedu mako so hbe ɓennitii walla habɓee.
2. **No bingel ngel woni?** Hbe bingel ngel woodi ƴellitaare (life signs) — habɓde, doggol ɓernde, no cifol mun?
3. **Nokkuuji lekki:** Hokku mo lekki ittooji naange (uterotonics) hono **oxytocin** walla **misoprostol** ngam suɓde reedu (uterus) yo habɓu, ndenta ƴiiƴam heewɗam.

Miɗo ɗaɓɓe humpito e maale ɗiɗi ɗee gila mi hokka feere selannde, sabu ballal potel ko waɗtude jooni fof.

Ɓingel ma ɗon mari alamaji nyaw ɓernde malla yonki (bana pneumonia malla *congenital heart disease*), kanjum waɗata o somata so o ɗon musina, o fita wulande ha hoore, e o fofa dow-dow. Ɗiɗon ngoni alamaji hattara mawɗi (*danger signs*) ɗi mballataa yaasi sam, ngam salaago musingo e canjitgol fofugo ko huunde halkaynde ngel daayataa. Daada e baaba yo njaara ɓingel ngel asibiti mawɗo law-law ngam likitaji ndara ɓernde e yonki maako e masinji potuɗi.

Ta kuɗee mo musingo malla tookugo mo nyamdu wakkati o ɗon fofa dow-dow ngam o ta o fofira nyamdu haa ɓalel fofugo maako (*aspiration*). Yahaago asibiti e yaasi kanjum tan woni laawol hisnugo yonki ɓingel ma e heɓugo kugal likitaaji potuɗi.

column19: Ɓingel maaɗa ɗon mari nyawu ngungu (pneumonia) ɗum waɗi o ɗon fofa bee sautu e ɓanndu mako ɗon nanga, ɗum walaa kwali ɓerde amma ɗum haani yaawgo nastugo asibitiiru. column19: Fiyannde ɓernde lawlaw e uppugo lari dande ɗon holla wonde ɓernde maako ɗon tampe sabu ƴiiƴam ɗon ɓeydoo nder redu, amma ɗum waawi wonde maande *anemia* (ƴiiƴam fusta) walla *heart failure* (ɓernde ronki hawkugo no haaniri). Nyawu *anemia* tiiɗngu walla *heart failure* ɗon haɗa ɓingel redu heɓugo oksisin (oxygen) e nyaamdu no haaniri, ɗum waawi haɗugo mawnugo mako. Alamaji kalluɗi ɗi o haani ngi'ugo ko: fofaango tiiɗngo wakkati fere fuu, ɓerne ciiwol, ɓeydugo teewu dow kafaaje, e ɓingel redu dillataa no haaniri. Ngam andugo sanadu, o haani yargo asibiti ngam ɓe ƴeewa ƴiiƴam maako (Full Blood Count/PVC), ECG, e *Echocardiogram* ngam andugo no ɓernde maako hawkirta. O haani jogaago nyawu ngun law bee likita ngam wallitugo laaɓal maako e ɓingel redu, o yara kuuje ɗe ɗon ɓeyda ƴiiƴam (iron/folic acid) bee yamiroo likita.

column19:
Nyaw ngu ɓingel maada mari ɗum woni **Tetanus cukalel kesal (Neonatal Tetanus)**, saabe o waawaa muynugo kadi ɓanndu makko ɗon yoora malla o ɗon waɗa paɗɗe. Ɗum ɗon heɓa bacci to inna maɓɓe heɓay batte (vaccines) tetanus wakkati o woni bee reedu, kadi to kotoltol ngol laaɓnaaka no haandiri wakkati danygol. Ko ngol ta'iraa laɓi laaɓɗum boo, mborbiri ɗon waawi nastugo ngam ɓingel walaa mbeɗka (immunity) tawaangal diga ɓanndu inna mum mo heɓay batte tetanus.

O ɗon mari haaje luttugo haa asibiti nyannde hande ngam heɓugo lekkiiji bana *tetanus immunoglobulin*, *antibiotics*, e lekkiije ɗe'itintooje ɓanndu makko ngam hisnugo yonki makko. Gam reengo ɗum yeeso, nafata rewɓe reeduɓe fuu mbeɗa batte tetanus pat ko haandi ngam reenugo bacci maɓɓe danyeteɗi.

Alamaji ɗi a siftii—ɗufte/ɓirta ndiyam e hunduko, dande ko wa’i no jogii, hulde ndiyam, damuwa/tampere—ɗi mbaawi fota e **rabies** ɓawo ɗaɓɓere rawaandu, kadi jarrabooji asibiti ɗi mbaawi wonde “normal” kono rabies ɗon woodi.
So alamaji ɗi fuɗɗii, rabies ko nyaw bonɗo ɗo keewi ɗaɓɓude yonki; yahaa **emergency/asibiti mawɗo jooni**, hoto ɓooy.
So ɗaɓɓere ndee ko hesere, wuddo gulɗo ndee e saabulu e ndiyam ɗo yahata miniti 15, ngam heɓa **vaccine rabies** balɗe 0, 3, 7, 14, e **rabies immunoglobulin** to gulɗo so gulɗo no tiiɗi.
Hoto haɗ vaccine sabu rawaandu ndee no ndaartee balɗe 10; tetanus e antibiotic no waawi soklude.
Hoto mem ɗufte mako; kala mo saliva mako naati e gulɗo, hunduko walla gite, o yahaa heɓa kariya rabies.

Idan jini ya yi karanci, zai sa jiki ya yi rauni, kwakwalwa ta yi nauyi, kuma mutum ya kasa jin dadin abinci yadda ya kamata. Haka kuma, yana da kyau ka fara cin abinci mai dauke da sinadarin jini kamar ganyen kuka, nama, da kayan lambu domin karfafa jiki. Alamaaji ɗi o hollata ɗii, haa teeŋti noon ko ɓeydugol reɗu e majjere (shock), ko ɗum nandi no woppude reedu nder falndu (ectopic pregnancy) walla sorru ɗo yani, ɗum addani ƴiiƴam heewɗam ƴellitde nder reɗu.
Ngam hisnude yonki makko, ko yaawɗe yahdude e opitaal mawɗo ɗo ɓe mbaɗata opereeji (surgery/laparotomy) ngam daɗndude ƴiiƴam ɗam ƴelliti nder reɗu, tawa ko doktojo ƴoƴɗo (gynecologist) woni ɗo.
Yaajtin rokkude mo iyam ɗam ɗo rufata (IV fluids) e oksijen e nder laawol ngol, kono yaawi heɓde ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion) ngam rokkude mo sabu o daɗii no feewi.
So o yari to opitaal, ɓe mbaawa rokkude mo batteji (injections) bana oxytocin walla misoprostol e lekkiji ngam wallaade haɗkude ƴiiƴam ɗam yaltude.
Tiiɗna acca ɗum waɗtude yaawtugol mawngol, sabu lekkiji walla batteji tan mbaawataa hisnude nguurndam makko so tawii ko opereeji ɗen poti.

column19: Bandu ɓiɗɗo ɗiɗo maa - gite mum e ɓalli mum jaloriiɗe (jaundice), zazzabi, ronkugo nyaamugo, tampere, e diwtaango - ɗi kollirta bone rewti hasu (severe malaria) e nder ɓalli ɗi jaawti wonugo hepatitis (jarabjari maa liver problem) walla anemia sattunde. Jaundice e jaloroji maa hollita ko ɓernde (liver) ndi don nafta walla ɗiɗo ƴiiƴam don liɓee (hemolysis) - ɗum yaha e severe malaria walla hepatitis A/B/E ko rewti nder ndiyam ngenndiiɗam. Alaa haaje maa hebbina min woppa - waɗɗi maa yaha sibiti ngenndi (general hospital) walla yara ɗum tampi (referral) sabu ɗum bone mawɗo baawɗo warugo. Toɗɗe ɗe ɓe waɗta: malaria test (RDT/blood film), liver function test, hepatitis screening e full blood count ngam anndugo ko waɗi. Naw ɓe jotta sibiti mawɗo sabu jaawgol ndaartugol e safaara ko waɗɗi ngam heɓugo hisugo maɓɓe.

column19: Alamaaji ɗin njiyata ko e ñawuuji mawɗi ko wayi no ñawu ƴiiƴam (TB), ñawu ngaloppitiri (liver/kidney), walla ñawu ɓernde, ko ɗum waɗata o waawi hootaade opitaal ngam ƴeewteede laaɓtunde. Wotoɗ hokka mo lekki keso e hoore maa tawa ko doktoor ƴeewtii mo, sabu leɗɗe ɗe ngalaa faamare mbaawi bonnude cellal makko. Ngam o waawa dawayde e joodagol belɗum, doktoor ina waawi hokkude mo leɗɗe woppitɗe ɓuuɓri (diuretics) ngam ustude ɗoggol ngol kono ko e les njiimaandi makko tan. Woppitii ndokkude mo ceene (namre) e nder ñaamdu, ndokkaa mo ñaamdu cellundu, o rewa wasiyaaji doktoor ɗii haa timma. Tiiɗno yaajnee nawra mo to opitaal ɗo doktoor en ngoni ngam ɗoftaare waɗata laaɓtunde e hokkude mo safrirde nde haani ko yaawi.

Ko nanta ɗon bana ɓernde fiyata e sembe ƴiiƴam (BP) ɓeydata saabe kulol gorko ma, ɗum masiibo her cellal ma e ɓiɗɗo mo a rorata.

Toɗu huutorgo lekki gargajiya ngam ɗum waawaa safrugon caɗeele kulol e BP nden e woodi ko bona reedu ma.

A ɗon mari haaje kisal, ɗum waɗi sey a heɓa goɗɗo mo hooli-ɗaa her saare ma ko kuutortooɓe haala rewɓe (*social workers*) ngam wallugo ma her haala gorko ma nden a heɓa jonde jam.

Sey a wara asibiti ko rabi mbele likitaji ndara no sembe ƴiiƴam ma jortortoo nden ɓe mballa ma bee lekkiiji tattaɓinaaji cellal hakkilo e kulol.

Kisal ma e kisal ɓiɗɗo ma woni ko ɓuri mawnugo jooni, nden min ɗon ɗoo ngam wallugo ma nder caɗeele ɗiɗi ɗon fuu.

column19: Alamaaji ɗii ko maande ɓernde teddungal e nder reedu (preeclampsia), ko nyau keewɗo waɗde e rewɓe reeduɓe tawa ko caɗeele ƴiiƴam comci (placenta) ngaddata ɓernde mawnugol e ɓuuɓri mooftugol ndiyam. Ee, nyau nguinaango nguu ina waawi bonnude cellal jom suudu e ɓiɗɗo reedu, haa teeŋti e sahaa jibineede ko adii waktu (preterm labor). Alamaji potɗi addude mo to safrirde ko yaaju ko: hareeji hoore ɗiiɗɗi, ko yiytintee e gite (blurred vision), hare ɓernde les ɓalndu, e ɓuuɓri juuroore mawnunde. E nder ñaamdu, o foti ko ñaamdu feewndu ndu proteinji e kalsiyam (nɗiyam) keewɗi, wondude e ittude lamɗam e ñameele mborosɗe ɗe ngalaa ɗoftaare. Tawa ko e lebbi jeeɗiɗi o fuɗɗii winnditde lewru e hareeji, ko laaɓti yo o yah to doktoor kala ko yaawi ngam ƴeewnde ƴiiƴam ɗam e ndaarde ɓiɗɗo oo.

Ɓingel maa ɗon nawa nyaw nimse bee mettiri ɓernde (depression) ngam maide inna mum, kanjum waɗi o salato nyaamdu e o joɗoto feere makko. Nyaw ɗum ɗon huɓna bandu makko e ɓernde makko, nden ɗum ɗon hani wallitande likitaajo masin ngam ta o heɓa nyaw wonnya bandu (malnutrition).

Haa wuro, kollititon mo yiide masin, mballon mo o heɓa nyaamdu ndu o yiɗi seese-seese, e ta kuɗte mo bee semmbe walla haala kaaɗuka. Mballon deerɗiraaɓe makko ɓonno mo bee pijooji seese ngam o heɓta belɗum ɓernde makko e o heɓa o nyama. To o tokki e salaago nyaamdu, njaree mo asibiti jooni-jooni ngam likita’en mballa mo bee nyaamdu semmbiɗon e lekkiiji wallitayɗi ɓernde.

Mi faami hol ko waɗi; ɓingel ɓuri heɓde saɗaare sabu danyugo juuti, ɗum ina waawi waɗde “birth asphyxia” (oksijin heewaani e hoore), walla sukkar ƴiƴam lesɗi, infeshon, walla “seizure”.
To ɓingel ina dimbina akai‐akai, fowtugo/nyamde na saɗi, walla hendu moƴƴaani, ɗum ko haɗari—yo ɓe waɗ mo e ɗo ɓiɓɓe kecce njogoree: oksijin, wulnugo, sukkar, magani seizure, antibiotics, e dabbude ƴiƴam/sukka/kalsiyum.
Mi waawaa waɗde alkawali wonde o hisata walla o wartan no feewi; ɓe waɗi mo ɗo jooni jaawɗum, heɓugo jam ina ɓeyda.
Ɓiɓɓe wonɓe heɓi asphyxia ina waawi hisde e jam, amma woɓɓe ina heɓa caɗeele ɗo yeeso hono dimbinol, saɗaare jangu/yaadu, walla epilepsy, ngam ɗum follow‐up e likita ɓinngel ko alɗuɗum.
Debbo ɗo duuɓi 13 ko risk ɗuuɗi; ɓawo oo yo ɓe ɗaɓɓa family planning, antenatal care e jibinannde asibiti, e jaɓɓude shawara likita ko sauri to ɗum waɗi.

column19: Rufugo iyam sembe ɗam a waɗata ɗum alama boɗɗum holloore babal ɓingel ma ɗon laɓɓina iyam kalluɗam, ngam maajum taa darnu ɗam. Lootugo tagoore ɗo ɓuri koo ngal batal likita, ngam on ɗiɗo fuu on keɓtan sembe mooɗon lawlaw to on waɗi nii.

# Jaabawol

## Ko waddi nyawu ngu (Diagnosis)

Ndeen alaamaaji ɗi njeewtuɗaa - nawol hoore, daande tiiɗndo (dande wailtataako, "stiff neck"), foofaango peppetel (kuma), be fu ɓandu, e kadi mo yaaji ɓawo mako - kala ɗum tinndinta **meningitis** (nyawu je heɓi kelle ndogaango hakkille be daande). Ɗum ko nyawu tiiɗɗo je raɓata sanne, holli-jum e nokkuuji Afrika.

## Ko waɗi ngu waddi (Transmission)

Ndee nyawu **na raɓata hakkunde yimɓe** rewrude foofaango, tuutaango, be gaddawo - ɗum saabi kadi be goɗɗo je o fotti be nyawɗo (be yahoygo banda gaman noon en jaabotoo). Ɗum firti mo be ɓe ngonduɗo fu na foti reentaade.

## Ko foti waɗeede (Management)

1. **Nawon mo law-law ha sibiti mawɗo** ngam ndee nyawu na waawi warugo e saa'i pamaro.
2. Dokta na foti waɗugo **lumbar puncture** ngam anndugo lallai nyawu ngu.
3. Nyawɗo na foti heɓugo **antibiotics tiiɗɗi** (kaŋ Ceftriaxone) law-law.
4. Yimɓe je ngonduɗo be mako na foti heɓugo **lekki reentaango** (prophylaxis, kaŋ Ciprofloxacin walla Rifampicin).

**Reftin:** Ɗum wanaa nyawu je jaaɓo waawi hisnude - nawon mo jooni jooni ha sibiti!

column19: Naa koo woy ɓuure sattinga haa en'di debbo woni nyawu kansa; ɗum waaway laataago ɓuure ndiyam (cysts) ko boo ɓuure ɓanndu meere nde naunataa (fibroadenoma). Yonde amjum ɗum waddata debbo ninga rufugo iyam ɗo ɓawo dayi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaundiku toi ɓe hokkata dada mai je rufugo iyam mai darata denbo o lorna sembe mako shawara hokkata dada mai be ɓingel mako.
column19:
Dada, rufugo ndiyam/amai no ɗuuɗi ɗo ɓawo jibingol e ñawndu sembe wonaa huunde nde ɓe foti faamude e suudu—o waawi heddii dehydration, malaria, infection ɗo ɓawo jibingol, walla BP toowɗo.
Ndeen debbo foti yaade sibiti jooni ngam ɓe ndaaru BP, zazzabi, malaria test, fitsari/jini, e no ndiyam ɓanndu mum woni; ɗum ena waawi soklude drip/ORS e maganin amai nde dokita hokkata.
So o no woodi zazzabi, mettagol reedu, jini/ruɓɓe ɗo leƴƴi, hoore metti, yiyde dimmɗe, walla o waawataa muynugol/nyamugo—ɗum ko emergency.
To ndeen, o suɓo ndiyam seɗɗa-seɗɗa, ORS, pap/kunun ɗanɗan, tee o woppita magani mo dokita waɗaani, sabu o no muynina ɓingel.
Ɓingel mako boo ɓe ndaaru: so o waawataa muynugo nono, o njogi zazzabi, ruttugo, walla o tampii, ɓe yahdu sibiti ɗoon ɗoon.

column19: Sannu Mrs. Akinleye, alamaji ishol bee saɗugo fofugo ɗi gorko ma wondi bee mum, ɗon nufa nyawu asma (asthma) koo bo nyawu poho (COPD) ɗum curde bee sollaji waddata, naa ngam ndottaku ba. Ko o waɗata arande, o faaɓa hoore maako daga sollaji, curde, bee jaangol ngam taa ɗum ɓesda mawnugo nyawu man. Dila mo asibiti bako nyawu man mawnira, ngam likita'en mbaɗa hoto gasi (Chest X-ray) bee ndaara tuuɗe maako (sputum test) ngam tabbitingo ko waddata ɗum koo bo asnee fiyande (TB). Likita'en ɓe mbinndan mo lekki pampamji (inhalers) ɗi o fofata nder poho ngam maɓɓitugo laawol hendu, bee lekki ishol ngam o waawa fofugo daidai. To on tokki kakkilanol ngol bee naftirgo lekki ɗin daidai, insha Allahu fofugo maako wartan daidai, o jooɗa bee jam.

Debbo do danyi ha sibiti meden lebbi jego ko saali. Owari sibiti man beh gorko mako haa o danyi bingel mardo lebbi jego mo be wardi beh mako jonta .
Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.
Ovi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda.
Ovi dojjere man halli on daga keya. Balde tati ko fuddi amma har turti.
Ovi de o musini mo fu, odo hokka mo lekki diyam jeh der gora- jeh be sorrata jeh dojjugo do- jeh o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara.
Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.
Bana pofde man to ta’a on do yaha dau jippa les kala wakkati fu.
Beh hultiri hanjum wadi beh waddi mo sibiti meden.
Jotta emol am hado hanjum on; min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo beh bingel do ha saare na? Larugo no pofde mako ta’ata beh dojjere do?
Min vindina be lekki dojjugo na? Ko en wada gwaje-gwaje dau bingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko bate?
column19: Wannan ɓingel ƙarƙuƙo yana nuna cewa ɗan ƙaramin yaro yana ɗauƙe da cutar ƙarfi ko kura (malaria) ko kuma cutar haɗari ɗin ƙarfi (sepsis) saboda ƙarfin jini da ƙarancin ƙaɗan. Akwai buƙatar ɗan ƙaramin yaron ya sami magungin kwarai (intravenous fluids) da magungin ƙarfi cikin gaggawa don kare rayuwarsa. Ana buƙatar ya samu magungin kura (antimalarials) da kuma binciken jini don sanin cutar da ke damunsa. A wannan yanayi, yana da kyau a yi masa magani a asibiti domin ba da kulawar da ke daidaita yanayin jinin sa. Ana bukatar kiyaye jinin sa don kada ya yi ƙarfi sosai ko kuma ya mutu.

column19: Tari jemma bee bone fofaago ɗo wara ngam kosam endi maɗa ɗo feewa wakkati jemma, naa ngam cuuɗi leɗɗe defirɗe on ba. Ngam helugo tari man, hooyu njumri (honey) laaɓundi bee ndiyam gulɗam hokka keccel man yara ngam o waawa ɗaanago. Ɓadnu ɓingel man haa yiite leɗɗe defirɗe man sosai, ngam nguleeki bee cuuɗi man ɗon maɓɓita ɓokko-ɓokko ɓingel ngam fofaago laaɓa. To o saali musinugo, acca hokkugo mo endi, hokka mo ndiyam ɓulɗam bee suga tan ngam o heɓa semmbe. Kanjum on woni lekki ɓuri wooɗugo ngam ɓingel maɗa sella, bo o ɗaana boɗɗum wakkati jemma.

column19: Assalamu alaikum. Wuji gonɗi e ɓandu bingel ngel e caɗeele fofugo mum ko sabu danygol juutngol e ŋakkere sembe iyam yumma sahaa danygol, ɗum waɗi ngel heɓa torra walla ŋakkere oksijen duuɓi seeɗa. Ammaa jooni, toppitagol ngol oksijen e huutoragol incubator ko maande moƴƴere, bingel ngel hisi, ɗum holli wonde alaa caɗeele ɓerɗe. Miɗo wasiyoo ɓe njokku ƴeewndo e toppitagol yumma mum e suka ngel to asibiti haa law, kono alaa ko hulɓini; ko ɓuri heewde e sukaaɓe ɓeeɓnooɓe ɗum no moƴƴina.

column18: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
column19: Miɗo nanna muusol maa, amma to alamraaji ñawu rawandu puɗɗiima yaltude e ɓanndu, walaa asibiti walla safara baawɗo cellinde ɗum, ngam rawandu ko maayde to alamraaji mum nji'aama. Lekki gargajiya waawaa warde virus rawandu, ngam majjum naatay haa e kwakwalwa, waɗi cellal majjum ko tan ko allurar rawandu (vaccine) ɓaawo ñamugol ko adii alamraaji puɗɗaade. Jonta, yahree mo asibiti mawɗo (General Hospital) ngam ɓe kokka mo safaraaji ustooji muusol (palliative care) haa o maaya e jam, kadi ɓe woɗɗina mo ngam o raaɓaa yimɓe. Ngam hisnude yimɓe men, to rawandu ñamii neɗɗo, lootee nokkuure nden e sabulu e ndiyam, nden dogon asibiti ngam heɓugo allurar rawandu law.

column19: Nyawu Suberu nguu hollitii wonde gabaare makko taƴi ngam ɗojju ngu neeɓi, ɗum waɗi ɓokko-ɓokko (lungs) makko ronki. Dabare ɓurnde wooɗugo ngam o yamɗita, kanko o sooda lekki ɗojju mbaleehi (cough syrup) o jillindira bee nebbam boɗejam, o yara laaɓi tati nyande fuu ngam o ɗaana gabaare nden. O haɓɓa gabaare makko bee wudere tiiɗunde ngam taa o fuufa masin, kadi o hoota o ɗaano e ɓawo makko. Walaa haaje o yaha asibiti fahin ngam ƴeewndo (test) walla hooto (X-ray), ngam goro bee jumri ɗi o naftiri ɗin mbari kootu nyawu ngun nder ɓandu. To o tokki ndee dabare, gabaare makko ɓuuɓan, o waawa fuufugo no haanirta, o heɓa jamu makko lawlaw.

column18: Dada joɗata ha fattude amin do mari redu je bingel mako didamo ha fuddarde redu mai komai oyaha dedai odo nana beldum mingal fere do wara amma lewru sadda ko sali do o fuddi nanugo lesdu mako do nawa yende naudum mai wadi mo sosai har dakai o darata boddum Nibai samɗi rufugo iyam sosai rufugo iyam mai ɗa no rufata ɗon ba rufi sosai kuma wati mo comri oɗo somi de o lari iyam mai sai o wurtiri tani ɗon ko fe’i be ɓingel mako gorko mako yawi vallni mo be yahi sibiti. kanjum dunigo les redu ha redu rufugo iyam sosai do alama hattara don na je dada ko bingel ha redu mai dume on alama goddo larata redu mai don damuwa don lekki je darnata naudum mai. ɓe darna iyam mai je naunata bingal mai je naunata bingal mai.
column19: Naawalla reedu e rufugo iyam soosay bee lebbi joweego e rabeere ɗon holla alaama masiibo reedu bana 'placental abruption' (ɗon woni seedugo ɓii-reedu bako wakkati). Ɗum ɗon waɗi masiibo ha dow yonki dada e mbingel mum gam iyam rufugo ɗon wadda somugo, ɗon kadi suttata hisgo yonki maɓɓe. Sey dada o yaha sibiti joni-joni ngam heɓugo wallitteego yaawungo ngam hisngo yonki dada e mbingel. Kadi, alamaaji masiibo goɗɗi bana faɗugo yonki, somugo soosay ko mbingel yandugo law mari haaje nyawnditirgo yaawngo.

column19: Iyam dottiidam, nawugo les reedu, ɓernde diwaya, e tampiri ɗi daada yi'ata sati ɗiɗi ɓaawo danyugo wanaa alhaali laaɓuɗo; ɗum alamaaji heddere neesa (retained placenta) luttunɗi nder reedu malla nyawu mbuuɓri (infection) sabboojum ustaare iyam. Nawugo les jaaburu ɗon wara ngam reedu ɗon tiiɗa wurtina ko luttiri nder, kadi diwaygo ɓernde e tampiri ɗon holla ɓandu maako ronkii iyam (anemia) ngam iyam rufaangam ɗuɗɗum. Alamaaji kulɓiniiɗi ɗi daada keso handi watta hakkilo be maajum kanjum woni wurtungo iyam dottiidam ɗuuɗɗum, ndiyam uuccam, ɓandu wuli, e jaasngo ɓandu masin. Taa o tokku haala yimɓe wi'ooɓe ɗum fota koo meeɗai, o yaha asibiti lawlaw likita'en lara mo, ɓe ndokka mo lekki laɓɓinirki reedu be ɓeydinki iyam. Heɓugo magani haa asibiti wakkati maajum hattan rufugo iyam majjum, hoosa nyawu ngun, nden bo lortina cellal e yamɗeeki maako.

column18: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
column19: Rawandu mai gati wutar bango (heart rate) na yara ya kamata ya kasance tsakanin 80 zuwa 140 beats per minute (bpm) lokacin da yake kwanciya, amma yana iya kai zuwa 160 bpm idan yana wasan motsa jiki. Idan rawandu ya wuce wannan, yana nuna cewa zuciya tana bugawa da sauri (tachycardia), wanda zai iya kasala da jini da zuciya ke zubarwa. A asibiti, muna duba wannani don sanin ko akwai yara da ciwon numfashi, fever, ko kuma rashin samun ruwa a jiki (dehydration). Idan rawandu ya daidaita da yanayin yaran, yana nuna cewa zuciya tana aiki yadda ya kamata don ba da jini zuwa jiki. Don haka, dole ne mu tantance dalilin saurin bugun zuciya ta hanyar gwajin jini da kuma duba yanayin numfashi na yaran.

column18: Dottijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo vi o ɗo nana hore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiɗi be kuma fofe peppetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari ammugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawatoi hokkata mo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko sedda sedda warin. Dottijo mai vi warini mo jamma den bo halli jotta min emi mo bo o do lara hite na o vi a gam hite o tull mo nawol hore min nemi mo fu hala fufe ha bandu mako ko do nawa sosai ko sedda sedda dottijo mai vi fu finimo patdu be kuma o wawata viwugo da pellel. vilel gotel amma ɗo nyamo ɓawo kanjum min emi mo ko o fotti be nyaudo o vi wala ha o yahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe damde amin ha likita kanju don ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddata dum haru o wala wailita dande be fufe ko hatoi ha bandu mako dume waddata dum nyau je rabata on. hundeji fere am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en anda ta lalle ko hebi mo heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta bako jaborugo vurtan.
column19: Alaamaji ɗi on mbiyi bana naawol hoore jamma, daande tiiɗnde, gite mbawataa laarugo annoora (hite), bee fofe vurtooje haa ɓandu ɗon holla nyawu nguykinoowu bi'eteengu Sankarau (Meningococcal Meningitis). Nyawu ngu'u raabotoongu masin, ngu ɗon yaara puyooje bee mbuuwu (bacteria) nder ndiyam hoore bee ɓawo, ngam maajum o waawataa waylitugo daande maako. Ngam tabbatingo nyawu man, likita'en haani ɓe koo'a ƴiiƴam maako malla ɓe njuwa kunkuru ɓawo maako ɓe hoo'a ndiyam (lumbar puncture) ngam laarugo nder masin asibiti (lab test). Amma ngam Sankarau ɗon wara neɗɗo lawlaw, taa munnee haa sakamakko warta; on dila hokke mo lekki tufooji ndiyam (IV antibiotics) bana *Ceftriaxone* jooni-jooni ngam hisnugo yonki maako. O haani o rumbine haa suudu asibiti mawnundu lawlaw ngam heɓugo lura, nden yimɓe wuro maako bo haani ɓe hokke lekki ngam taa ɓe raabe.

Woto ndokku ɓingel ngel walla reenuwo ɗum leɗɗe dogooje ɗe ngalaa wasiyaaji doktoor, sibu docco tiiɗngo ina waawi baɗde caɗe mawɗe balɗe ɗe njaltata so ƴeewaaka e sahaa.

Aɗa waɗi yahde e dokotoro on walla nurse on ngam ɓe winndora maaji ɗiɗi e hakkunde wanngorde, walla ɓe addi ma takarda e ɗemngal feewngal.

Haa ɓuri, naamni ko ɗum waɗi waɗde so a yaltude dose, so bingel ɗum waɗi waɗde e leydi jine, e haray ɗum no feewi kala.

column19: Bingel ngal ina haani yaafere yaajnde e juuɗe doktoor opereeji sabu ko ɗum hernia rawandu nde caɗeele, ɗe addii vurtugol, mette, e ƴiiƴam caggade nde neɗɗo waɗi heen ko feewi e hoore mum. Ɗuum ina waawi wonde ko ƴiye ɗe njippiima (strangulation) walla ko nyawbu mawndu, ɗe noon ko yaajde haani safreede seeɗa kadi ina waawi warde bingel ngal so opereeji mbaɗaaka. Safrooɓe ɓee mbaɗa opereeji ngam feewnude ɗuum, wondude e rokkude leɗɗe nyawbu (antibiotics) ngam haɗde nyawbu ɗe ngaddi ɗum ko adii. Hernia rawandu e sukaaɓe ɓuri heewde ko ina sella hoore mum haa e duuɓi njoyo, kono golle gaaɗe (gargajiya) ina bonna ɗum tee ina addana ɗum caɗe mawɗe. Tiiɗno, ngam hisnude nguurndam bingel ngal, acca ko ɓe mbaɗata kala e hoore maɓɓe, ngam rokkude ɗum yaafere laawɗunde e nder asibiti.

Alaamaaji ɗi—ɓernde fiyude law, jungo ɗi dimbude, yareede/huutorgo, e uppugo dande yeeso—ɓuri yiɗde no nyawu **thyroid/goitre (hyperthyroidism)**, wonaa ko reedu tan; haa noon anemia, malaria walla BP toowiɗo maɓɓe mbaawi waɗde ɗum.
O haani yaade asibiti/likita gila jooni ngam waɗde **BP, PCV/Hb, malaria test, urine protein, TSH e Free T4**, e ƴeewde ɓingel.
So thyroid ɗum ɗo fiiɗi, ina waawi waɗde haɗari: ɓernde debbo tampude, ɗaɓɓude ɗeeɗe, reedu yaade ko jaango, ɓingel mawnataa no feewi, walla ɓingel jogiɗe thyroid problem.
Ɗum ina wondi lekki kisɗi e reedu so likita hokki: **PTU** ko methimazole (no wakkati reedu), e lekki ɓernde lawlaw ko wardi seɗɗa; hoto o huutoro lekki goitre ko yare-yareji tawa likita wallaani.
So o heɓii honto faa o semmbitii, o ɗaɓɓi henndu, o fainti, ƴiƴam wari, ɓingel yiltataa, walla hoore mawni/BP toowi—ɗum ko emergency, yaa asibiti ɗon ɗon.

column18: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. column19: Dada o ɗon wondi e caɗeele danygol mawɗe, waato rufugo ƴiiƴam (PPH) e jonte danygol (sepsis) je waɗi o ɗon ɓuuɓa e juuɗe e koyɗe bo o walaa sembe. Ɓinngel duuɓi gootel no hirlita, no ɗojja/yiɓɓa, no fofa doole walla no weeɓi, ko **alama haɗari**—ɗum waawi wonde malaria bonɗo, pneumonia, meningitis walla dehydration.
Hokkude lekki gargajiya woodaani ndee; **yahee asibiti jaajum** ngam ɓe waɗa gwaji malaria, jini, sukari, ɓe hokku mo lekki, ruwa IV walla oxygen so waɗi.
Damuwa ɓernde ina waawi hoynude neɗɗo, kono ɗum tan alaa sembe waɗde ɓinngel hirlita; asthma ɓuri waɗde fowru/huɓɓugo ɗum, wonaa hirlitagol.
So o hirlitii, wallit mo e sera, hoto naatnu huunde e hunduko, hoto waɗu lekki e hunduko; so o yiɗi yara, hokku ORS walla ɗumɗum seɗɗa-seɗɗa.
So o waawaa yara, o ɗojja kala huunde, o fofa doole, walla o tampii/sunti, **hoto ɗenti—yahee emergency jooni.**
