Debbo do danyi ha sibiti meden lebbi jego ko saali. Owari sibiti man beh gorko mako haa o danyi bingel mardo lebbi jego mo be wardi beh mako jonta .
Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.
Ovi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda.
Ovi dojjere man halli on daga keya. Balde tati ko fuddi amma har turti.
Ovi de o musini mo fu, odo hokka mo lekki diyam jeh der gora- jeh be sorrata jeh dojjugo do- jeh o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara.
Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.
Bana pofde man to ta’a on do yaha dau jippa les kala wakkati fu.
Beh hultiri hanjum wadi beh waddi mo sibiti meden.

Hala no a haali ɗon holli ɓ is is ɓingel maa ɗon mari ko ɓi'etee **'ɓandu hoyndu' (hypotonia)**, ɗun woni hoyfeego jokke e ɓalndu ɓingel.

Ɗum ɗon waawi yaade saabi matsalaji ngaandi, ɗaɗi (nerves), ko bo ɓalndu (muscles) ɓingel man.

Ko ɓuri boɗɗum woni a wadda ɓingel man asibiti ngam likita lara ɗum, o waɗa kajeji ngam anndugo ko saabi e no ɓe mballitorta ɗum.

Wakati a ɗon joggo ko a ɗon ɓanta ɓingel man, joggu hoore e daande maako boɗɗum ngam sala lortugo gada ko yeeso.

Heɓugo huwtoraandu jaawndum bana physiotherapy e magunguna waawan wallugo ɓingel man sanne.

Ɓingel duuɓi sappo e tati ɗon foti heɓugo caɗeele danyngo ngam ƴi'e ɓandu mako njaajaai tawan, ko waɗi ɓingel maajum heɓaai fofaango (oxygen) boɗɗum wakkati nakisa.

To ɓingel ngel hisi, ngel waawan wartugo kal e kal, amma e woodi tammunde ngel heɓa caɗeele ngaanndu (brain damage) malla la'ugo ɓandu ngam fofaango taƴi wakkati danyngo neeɓi ɗon.

Salugo seekaago (CS) ngam hoosugo ɓingel law waɗi danyngo neeɓi masin, ɗum bo ɗon nasta e ko waddata naawalla maande hoore (cerebral palsy) haa ɓikkoi kakketeeɓi.

Jonta kam, sey ɓingel ngel lutta haa asibiti nder kulle likita'en ngam heɓa fofaango e lekkiiji har ngel warta garau.

Ɓawo ɗon, dowlidiri on ɗon ngarta e ɓingel asibiti wakkati fuu ngam likita'en ndaara to mawnugo ngel e ngaanndu maagel ɗon yaha boɗɗum walaa caɗeele.

column19: Tarihi jemma e fofugo ɓingel lewru jetati ɓuri heɓugo sabu ndiyam iwde ɓawo hunuko (post-nasal drip), ruɓɓaare reedu artugo (reflux), ko tarihi kooki (pertussis), ɗum ɓuri tammbugo to ɓingel ɗon lelii. Alamuji majjum hawti e tarihi tiiɗɗo jemma, fofugo caggal tarihi, cuɓal nder hunuko, e marugo nguleeki ɓanndu. Ha hasare, mawninago hoore ɓingel on seeɗa to o ɗon ɗaanii, e huutorgol saline drops ngam laɓɓingol hunuko mako kafin o nyaama ko o ɗaana. Hokku mo nonniri seeɗa-seeɗa ko ɓuri heɓugo ngam haɗugo reedu mako heɓugo haa o fofa, taa hokku mo lekki tarihi baawal ngal likita yamiraali. Likita on laaran mo ngam hokkugo lekki haaniiki, hawti e antibiotics to ko pertussis, ngam ɓingel on heɓa ɗaanaago boɗɗum jemma.

column19: Ɗum wonaa nyau reedu, ko nyau ɓernde (heart failure) waddi fiyugo ɓernde be haukugo dande sabu ɓernde makko wawaa pumpugo yiam haa yonɗi. Haukugo dande on sanadun ndiyam jooɗago nder bucu, ɗum wawan mema maunugo bingel sabu yiam be oksijin yonataa mo. Alamaaji kalludum je o foti taskugo ko: majjugo hanki, cango ɓernde, ɓuɓɓugo haa yonɗi, be tafugo yiam. Bawo dayugo (postpartum), alaaji ɗi o don yiya (iyam sedda sedda, nawɓe redu, tampere, saka'a berde, ɗiɗi les jaburu) njeñtin walla nde ni:

**Ko waawi wonde:**
- **Yaakuru** (anemia): iyam ley e nawɓe redu e tampere puɗɗi ɗum, wonde neɗɗo danyi ndaɗi. Ɗum ko ko ɓuri jogaade e rewɓe danyɓe Nijeriya.
- **Njiwu ley** (puerperal infection/endometritis): saka'a berde, nawɓe redu e iyam e ley ndaɗi maa njiwu maa tokka.
- **Njiwu ɓernde/PPD** (postpartum depression): saka'a berde e tampere e miijo bonngo.

**Ko yiɗaa wonde (danger signs):** iyam heewnde, iyam sawnde e sabbeere, nj­eyngo, saka'a berde heewnde, sabbeere, walla miijo warde hoore mum.

**Matakiiji:**
1. **Wallu mo yaawtinde asibiti** — ɗum ko ko ɓuri himmude sabu iyam heewnde e njiwu ko ndaɗira maayde.
2. To asibiti: ndaartee **yaakuru** (haemoglobin), ndaartee **njiwu**, ndaartee iyam. Yiɗaa lekki yaakuru (iron/folate), lekki njiwu (antibiotics) so alaa.
3. To iyam heewnii, waawi haɓɓaade **ƴiiƴam** (transfusion).
4. Tinno mo e miijo makko, ittu tampere.

Sabu ko himmi, addu mo asibiti jooni.

# Jaabawol

Ndaw mbaadi ɓingel ngel wondi e safaara (asthma / doole hendu maa bronchiolitis / pneumonia), gam damuwa, buleendi (cyanosis), e turgo hunduko maa ɓoggol ko maanaaji doole nguleeki e ɓalɓal.

**Ko ɓe foti waɗde:**

1. **Wallitde ɓingel yeeso** – Ɓe foti hokkude ngel **oksijin** (oxygen) so tan ngel woodi, sabu buleendi ngel hollirta ɗemngal ngel yiˊata haɓɓe (heɓoygo hendu boɗɗum).

2. **Safaara doole hendu** – Ɓe foti hokkude **salbutamol (Ventolin) e nebulizer** ngam udditde ɓoggi ɓingel ngam ngel foota no moƴƴi, e **steroid (prednisolone maa hydrocortisone)** ngam ustude ɓalɓeeki.

3. **Antibiotics** – So woni pneumonia (safaara ɓalɓal ɓoggi), ɓe foti hokkude lekki antibiotic (wano amoxicillin).

**Ko himo foti hisnude:**
- Ɓingel ngel foti daroraade e safirdu (hospital admission) haa foota moƴƴi, hoto ngel yaha yeeso.
- So oksijin ngel ustii sanne, ngel foti nawreede to ICU maa nokku mawɗo ballal.

Miijo ngam yeeso: rokku daada ndaa hollira maa wallitde ɓingel maa fewndo asthma so ngel heɓi safaara moƴƴa e sahaa mum.

column19: Debbo on waawi heɓde ñawu ƴiiƴam ɓaawo danygol (puerperal sepsis) walla kosam ɗam heddii nder reedu, ko ɗum waɗi o warii e maɓɓe ɓuuɓri nde mettundi e ƴiiƴam. Ko ɗum yaafata, ko himmude yo o artu to sibiti ko yaawi, kanko e bingel makko, ngam rokkude antibiotikji nder ƴiiƴam (IV) ngam hisnude nguurndam maɓɓe. Hokkude lekji galleeji walla lekji ndiyam, hono ko o ɗaɓɓiri, ko hattannde mawnde nde waawi yaajnude ñawu nguu e bonnude cellal maɓɓe. Bingel man nden fuu, ko himmugo ƴeewtaade mo kadi to sibiti ngam hokkugo mo lekki potɗi sabu o yalti ko e sibiti tawa o yaafinaani. Alaa doktoor mo waawi winndude lekki ko ɓuri heewde e ngooluum sahaa tawa o ƴeewtaaki mo, ko ɗum waɗi ko yaawi e sibiti ko laawol tan ngam cellal makko e bingel man.

Shi yasa ya zama dole ka nemi taimakon likita cikin gaggawa don kare rayuwarsa daga haɗari.
